def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])

                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,

                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),

                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],

                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])

                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],

                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],

    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):

    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):

                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),

            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))

        quantity,

    )

    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }
    candidate_role_counts = collections.Counter(
        row["candidate_intent_role"]
        for row in no_fill_candidate_by_order.values()
    )
    require(
        sum(candidate_role_counts.values()) == 728,
        "无Fill候选角色未完整覆盖728个订单",
    )

    canceled_or_expired_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_status_standard_code"]) in {"CANCELED", "EXPIRED"}
    ]
    require(len(canceled_or_expired_orders) == 743, "取消/失效订单不是743")
    unfilled_cancel_candidate_rows = []
    for order in sorted(
        canceled_or_expired_orders,
        key=lambda row: (
            parse_time(row["order_create_time_utc"]),
            text(row["order_id"]),
        ),
    ):
        order_id = text(order["order_id"])
        execution = execution_by_order.get(order_id)
        no_fill = execution is None
        candidate = (
            no_fill_candidate_by_order[order_id]
            if no_fill
            else {
                "candidate_cycle_ids": execution["position_cycle_ids"],
                "candidate_cycle_count": len(
                    [
                        item
                        for item in (
                            text(execution["position_cycle_ids"]) or ""
                        ).split("|")
                        if item
                    ]
                ),
                "position_at_create_candidates": None,
                "candidate_intent_role": "FILLED_PORTION_ACTUAL_EFFECT",
                "candidate_evidence_level": "E1+E2",
                "candidate_confidence": "高",
                "candidate_basis": (
                    "仅已成交Fill产生实际仓位变化；未成交剩余数量不计入"
                ),
            }
        )
        unfilled_cancel_candidate_rows.append(
            {
                "candidate_link_id": stable_id("S05-OCAN", order_id),
                "order_id": order_id,
                "source_order_record_id": order["standard_record_id"],
                "symbol": order["symbol_standard"],
                "side": order["side_standard_code"],
                "order_type": order["order_type_standard_code"],
                "order_status": order["order_status_standard_code"],
                "order_create_time_utc": order["order_create_time_utc"],
                "order_update_time_utc": order["order_update_time_utc"],
                "original_quantity": order["original_quantity"],
                "executed_quantity": order["executed_quantity"],
                "fill_count": int(execution["fill_count"]) if execution else 0,
                "no_fill_flag": "是" if no_fill else "否",
                "partial_fill_then_canceled_or_expired": (
                    "是" if execution is not None else "否"
                ),
                "actual_position_role": (
                    execution["order_position_role"] if execution else None
                ),
                "actual_fill_quantity_used": (
                    execution["total_fill_quantity"] if execution else "0"
                ),
                "unfilled_quantity_used_in_position": "0",
                **candidate,
                "business_fact_boundary": (
                    "候选意图不是成交事实；实际仓位只接受Fill"
                    if no_fill
                    else "已成交部分是事实；未成交剩余部分不影响仓位"
                ),
            }
        )

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }
    candidate_role_counts = collections.Counter(
        row["candidate_intent_role"]
        for row in no_fill_candidate_by_order.values()
    )
    require(
        sum(candidate_role_counts.values()) == 728,
        "无Fill候选角色未完整覆盖728个订单",
    )

    canceled_or_expired_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_status_standard_code"]) in {"CANCELED", "EXPIRED"}
    ]
    require(len(canceled_or_expired_orders) == 743, "取消/失效订单不是743")
    unfilled_cancel_candidate_rows = []
    for order in sorted(
        canceled_or_expired_orders,
        key=lambda row: (
            parse_time(row["order_create_time_utc"]),
            text(row["order_id"]),
        ),
    ):
        order_id = text(order["order_id"])
        execution = execution_by_order.get(order_id)
        no_fill = execution is None
        candidate = (
            no_fill_candidate_by_order[order_id]
            if no_fill
            else {
                "candidate_cycle_ids": execution["position_cycle_ids"],
                "candidate_cycle_count": len(
                    [
                        item
                        for item in (
                            text(execution["position_cycle_ids"]) or ""
                        ).split("|")
                        if item
                    ]
                ),
                "position_at_create_candidates": None,
                "candidate_intent_role": "FILLED_PORTION_ACTUAL_EFFECT",
                "candidate_evidence_level": "E1+E2",
                "candidate_confidence": "高",
                "candidate_basis": (
                    "仅已成交Fill产生实际仓位变化；未成交剩余数量不计入"
                ),
            }
        )
        unfilled_cancel_candidate_rows.append(
            {
                "candidate_link_id": stable_id("S05-OCAN", order_id),
                "order_id": order_id,
                "source_order_record_id": order["standard_record_id"],
                "symbol": order["symbol_standard"],
                "side": order["side_standard_code"],
                "order_type": order["order_type_standard_code"],
                "order_status": order["order_status_standard_code"],
                "order_create_time_utc": order["order_create_time_utc"],
                "order_update_time_utc": order["order_update_time_utc"],
                "original_quantity": order["original_quantity"],
                "executed_quantity": order["executed_quantity"],
                "fill_count": int(execution["fill_count"]) if execution else 0,
                "no_fill_flag": "是" if no_fill else "否",
                "partial_fill_then_canceled_or_expired": (
                    "是" if execution is not None else "否"
                ),
                "actual_position_role": (
                    execution["order_position_role"] if execution else None
                ),
                "actual_fill_quantity_used": (
                    execution["total_fill_quantity"] if execution else "0"
                ),
                "unfilled_quantity_used_in_position": "0",
                **candidate,
                "business_fact_boundary": (
                    "候选意图不是成交事实；实际仓位只接受Fill"
                    if no_fill
                    else "已成交部分是事实；未成交剩余部分不影响仓位"
                ),
            }
        )

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out
