def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,

                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"

            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"

                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out
