def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def candidate_intent(order: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created = parse_time(order["order_create_time_utc"])
        symbol = text(order["symbol_standard"])
        side = text(order["side_standard_code"])
        quantity = decimal_value(order["original_quantity"])
        candidates = [
            cycle
            for cycle in cycles_by_symbol[symbol]
            if cycle["_start"] <= created <= cycle["_end"]
        ]
        candidate_details = []
        for cycle in candidates:
            cycle_id = text(cycle["position_cycle_id"])
            prior_events = [
                event
                for event in events_by_cycle[cycle_id]
                if parse_time(event["event_time_utc"]) <= created
            ]
            position_at_create = (
                abs(decimal_value(prior_events[-1]["position_after"]))
                if prior_events
                else Decimal(0)
            )
            opening_side = (
                "BUY" if text(cycle["initial_direction"]) == "LONG" else "SELL"
            )
            if side == opening_side:
                role = "ATTEMPT_ADD"
            elif position_at_create and quantity < position_at_create:
                role = "ATTEMPT_REDUCE"
            else:
                role = "ATTEMPT_CLOSE_OR_REVERSE"
            candidate_details.append(
                {
                    "cycle_id": cycle_id,
                    "position_at_create": str(position_at_create),
                    "role": role,
                }
            )
        roles = {item["role"] for item in candidate_details}
        if not candidate_details:
            role = "NO_ACTIVE_CYCLE_AT_CREATION"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "无法确认"
            basis = "订单创建时点没有同symbol开放周期；不强行连接"
        elif len(roles) > 1:
            role = "MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_UNRESOLVED"
            evidence = "E5"
            confidence = "低"
            basis = "多个开放周期给出不同角色；不任意选择"
        else:
            role = next(iter(roles))
            evidence = "E3" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "E4"
            confidence = "高置信组合" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "弱候选"
            basis = (
                "symbol+创建时间+Side+创建时点仓位+委托数量；"
                + ("唯一开放周期" if len(candidate_details) == 1 else "多周期但角色一致")
            )
        return {
            "candidate_cycle_ids": "|".join(
                item["cycle_id"] for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_cycle_count": len(candidate_details),
            "position_at_create_candidates": "|".join(
                f"{item['cycle_id']}:{item['position_at_create']}"
                for item in candidate_details
            )
            or None,
            "candidate_intent_role": role,
            "candidate_evidence_level": evidence,
            "candidate_confidence": confidence,
            "candidate_basis": basis,
        }

    no_fill_orders = [
        order
        for order in orders
        if text(order["order_id"]) not in execution_by_order
    ]
    require(len(no_fill_orders) == 728, "无Fill订单不是728")
    no_fill_candidate_by_order = {
        text(order["order_id"]): candidate_intent(order)
        for order in no_fill_orders
    }

    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,

                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    v2_process = add_v2_tags(v1_process, "process", matched_cycles, matched_orders, source_to_b01, cycle_to_b01)

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],

) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,

                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),

        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),

def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",

            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],

    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,

                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def build_b01_cycles(
    cross_rows: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_cycles: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    by_cycle: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for row in cross_rows:
        if row["matched_v1_cycle_id"]:
            by_cycle[str(row["matched_v1_cycle_id"])].append(row)
    cycle_index = {str(r["position_cycle_id"]): r for r in v1_cycles}
    output = []
    for cid, fills in sorted(by_cycle.items(), key=lambda x: min(r["fill_time_utc"] for r in x[1])):
        base = cycle_index[cid]
        instances = sorted(set(r["copy_instance_id"] for r in fills))
        output.append(
            {
                "copy_cycle_evidence_id": stable_id("B01-CYCLE-EVID", cid),
                "position_cycle_id": cid,
                "copy_instance_id": "；".join(instances),
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": base.get("symbol"),
                "direction": base.get("initial_direction"),
                "cycle_start_time_utc": base.get("cycle_start_time_utc"),
                "cycle_end_time_utc": base.get("cycle_end_time_utc"),
                "fill_count": len(fills),
                "order_count": len(set(str(r["matched_v1_order_id"]) for r in fills)),
                "weighted_entry_price": base.get("weighted_entry_price"),
                "weighted_exit_price": base.get("weighted_exit_price"),
                "canonical_realized_pnl": base.get("canonical_realized_pnl"),
                "canonical_commission": base.get("canonical_commission"),
                "cycle_completion_status": base.get("cycle_completion_status"),
                "b01_fill_record_ids": "；".join(r["b01_fill_record_id"] for r in fills),
                "v1_fill_record_ids": "；".join(str(r["matched_v1_fill_record_id"]) for r in fills),
                "v1_order_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(str(r["matched_v1_order_id"]) for r in fills))),
                "account_origin_v2": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT",
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3",
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED",
                "double_count_status": "COUNT_ONCE_TWO_SOURCE_EVIDENCE",
                "false_cycle_risk_status": "已由v1 TradeId/OrderId、D2数量路径及D5仓位页交叉排除",
            }
        )
    return output

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out
