def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def build_b01_cycles(
    cross_rows: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_cycles: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    by_cycle: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for row in cross_rows:
        if row["matched_v1_cycle_id"]:
            by_cycle[str(row["matched_v1_cycle_id"])].append(row)
    cycle_index = {str(r["position_cycle_id"]): r for r in v1_cycles}
    output = []
    for cid, fills in sorted(by_cycle.items(), key=lambda x: min(r["fill_time_utc"] for r in x[1])):
        base = cycle_index[cid]
        instances = sorted(set(r["copy_instance_id"] for r in fills))
        output.append(
            {
                "copy_cycle_evidence_id": stable_id("B01-CYCLE-EVID", cid),
                "position_cycle_id": cid,

                "cycle_start_time_utc": base.get("cycle_start_time_utc"),
                "cycle_end_time_utc": base.get("cycle_end_time_utc"),
                "fill_count": len(fills),
                "order_count": len(set(str(r["matched_v1_order_id"]) for r in fills)),
                "weighted_entry_price": base.get("weighted_entry_price"),

                "v1_order_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(str(r["matched_v1_order_id"]) for r in fills))),

                "false_cycle_risk_status": "已由v1 TradeId/OrderId、D2数量路径及D5仓位页交叉排除",

        )

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

    by_cycle: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)

            by_cycle[str(row["matched_v1_cycle_id"])].append(row)

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def v1_fill_key(row: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    time = str(row.get("fill_time_utc") or "").replace(" UTC", "")
    return (
        time,
        str(row.get("symbol") or ""),
        str(row.get("side") or "").upper(),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_price")),
        clean_decimal(row.get("fill_quantity")),
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(row.get("commission")))),
        clean_decimal(row.get("realized_pnl")),
    )


def d2_key(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    quantity, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Quantity"))
    fee, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Fee"))
    pnl, _ = split_number_asset(raw.get("Realized Profit"))
    side = str(raw.get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper()
    return (
        raw.get("Time(UTC)"),
        raw.get("Symbol"),
        side,
        clean_decimal(raw.get("Price")),
        quantity,
        clean_decimal(abs(decimal_value(fee))),
        pnl,
    )


def cross_match_d2(
    d2: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_fills: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]], set[str], set[str]]:
    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], deque[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(deque)
    for row in sorted(v1_fills, key=lambda x: (int(str(x.get("trade_id") or 0)), int(str(x.get("source_row_number") or 0)))):
        index[v1_fill_key(row)].append(row)
    cross: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    matched_orders: set[str] = set()
    matched_cycles: set[str] = set()
    for b in sorted(d2, key=lambda x: (x["raw"]["Time(UTC)"], x["source_file"], x["source_row_number"])):
        candidates = index[d2_key(b["raw"])]
        matched = candidates.popleft() if candidates else None
        if matched:
            status = "B｜HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED"
            evidence = "E3"
            source_to_b01[str(matched["source_fill_record_id"])].append(b["standard_record_id"])
            if matched.get("order_id"):
                matched_orders.add(str(matched["order_id"]))
            for cid in str(matched.get("position_cycle_ids") or "").split("；"):
                if cid:
                    matched_cycles.add(cid)
        else:
            status, evidence = "C｜COPY_EXPORT_ONLY", "E3"
        cross.append(
            {
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH,
                "b01_fill_record_id": b["standard_record_id"],
                "source_file": b["source_file"],
                "source_row_number": b["source_row_number"],
                "copy_instance_id": INSTANCE[b["period"]]["copy_instance_id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": b["raw"].get("Symbol"),
                "side": str(b["raw"].get("Side") or "").split("/")[0].upper(),
                "fill_time_utc": fmt_utc(parse_utc(b["raw"].get("Time(UTC)"))),
                "fill_price": clean_decimal(b["raw"].get("Price")),
                "fill_quantity": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Quantity"))[0],
                "fee": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Fee"))[0],
                "realized_pnl": split_number_asset(b["raw"].get("Realized Profit"))[0],
                "coverage_class": status,
                "matched_v1_fill_record_id": matched.get("source_fill_record_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_trade_id": matched.get("trade_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_order_id": matched.get("order_id") if matched else None,
                "matched_v1_cycle_id": matched.get("position_cycle_ids") if matched else None,
                "matching_basis": "symbol+UTC秒+BUY/SELL+Decimal价格+数量+手续费绝对值+已实现盈亏；同外观行按v1 TradeId稳定一一配对",
                "evidence_level": evidence,
                "conflict_status": "无冲突",
                "double_count_action": "与v1同一真实成交，只保留两来源证据且计数一次" if matched else "仅跟单证据，进入v2候选",
            }
        )
    return cross, source_to_b01, matched_orders, matched_cycles

def build_b01_cycles(
    cross_rows: list[dict[str, Any]], v1_cycles: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    by_cycle: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for row in cross_rows:
        if row["matched_v1_cycle_id"]:
            by_cycle[str(row["matched_v1_cycle_id"])].append(row)
    cycle_index = {str(r["position_cycle_id"]): r for r in v1_cycles}
    output = []
    for cid, fills in sorted(by_cycle.items(), key=lambda x: min(r["fill_time_utc"] for r in x[1])):
        base = cycle_index[cid]
        instances = sorted(set(r["copy_instance_id"] for r in fills))
        output.append(
            {
                "copy_cycle_evidence_id": stable_id("B01-CYCLE-EVID", cid),
                "position_cycle_id": cid,
                "copy_instance_id": "；".join(instances),
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
                "portfolio_id": None,
                "symbol": base.get("symbol"),
                "direction": base.get("initial_direction"),
                "cycle_start_time_utc": base.get("cycle_start_time_utc"),
                "cycle_end_time_utc": base.get("cycle_end_time_utc"),
                "fill_count": len(fills),
                "order_count": len(set(str(r["matched_v1_order_id"]) for r in fills)),
                "weighted_entry_price": base.get("weighted_entry_price"),
                "weighted_exit_price": base.get("weighted_exit_price"),
                "canonical_realized_pnl": base.get("canonical_realized_pnl"),
                "canonical_commission": base.get("canonical_commission"),
                "cycle_completion_status": base.get("cycle_completion_status"),
                "b01_fill_record_ids": "；".join(r["b01_fill_record_id"] for r in fills),
                "v1_fill_record_ids": "；".join(str(r["matched_v1_fill_record_id"]) for r in fills),
                "v1_order_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(str(r["matched_v1_order_id"]) for r in fills))),
                "account_origin_v2": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT",
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE",

                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED",
                "double_count_status": "COUNT_ONCE_TWO_SOURCE_EVIDENCE",
                "false_cycle_risk_status": "已由v1 TradeId/OrderId、D2数量路径及D5仓位页交叉排除",
            }
        )
    return output

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,

                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def build_summary_models(position_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in position_rows:
        direction = text(row.get("position_side_standard_code"))
        require(direction in {"LONG", "SHORT"}, f"仓位摘要方向异常：{direction}")
        open_time = parse_time(row.get("open_time_utc"))
        close_time = parse_time(row.get("close_time_utc"))
        require(open_time is not None and close_time is not None, "仓位摘要时间为空")
        require(open_time <= close_time, "仓位摘要结束早于开始")
        summaries.append(
            {
                "summary_id": text(row.get("position_record_id"))
                or text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_record_id": text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_row_number": int(text(row.get("source_row_number")) or 0),
                "symbol": text(row.get("symbol_standard")),
                "direction": direction,
                "open_time": open_time,
                "close_time": close_time,
                "entry_price": decimal_value(row.get("entry_price"), allow_none=False),
                "entry_price_raw": text(row.get("entry_price")),
                "exit_price": decimal_value(row.get("exit_price"), allow_none=False),
                "exit_price_raw": text(row.get("exit_price")),
                "maximum_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("maximum_position_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "maximum_quantity_raw": text(row.get("maximum_position_quantity")),
                "closed_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("closed_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "closed_quantity_raw": text(row.get("closed_quantity")),
                "realized_pnl": decimal_value(row.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False),
                "realized_pnl_raw": text(row.get("realized_pnl")),
                "margin_mode": text(row.get("margin_mode_standard_code")),
                "position_status": text(row.get("position_status_standard_code")),
                "leverage": text(row.get("leverage")),
                "row": row,
                "assignments": [],
                "removed_order_ids": [],
            }

    summaries.sort(

            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    )
    residual_segments, residual_cycles, scope_rows = (

        key=lambda row: (

            row["account_scope"],

            row["position_cycle_id"],

    )

        fill_enhanced,
        segments,
        position_events,
        position_ledger,
        same_second_rows,
    ) = build_fill_and_event_outputs(fills, segments, annotations)

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def build_cycle_record(
    *,
    cycle_id: str,
    account_scope: str,
    symbol: str,
    position_mode: str,
    position_side: str,
    initial_direction: str,
    segments: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],
    completion_status: str,
    boundary_confidence: str,
    evidence_level: str,
    summary_id: str | None,
    summary_validation_status: str | None,
    warning_codes: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ordered = sorted(
        segments,
        key=lambda segment: (
            parse_time(segment.get("event_time_utc")),
            int(segment.get("segment_sequence") or 0),
            numeric_sort_key(segment.get("trade_id")),
        ),
    )
    opening_roles = {
        "OPEN_INITIAL",
        "OPEN_REVERSE",
        "ADD_POSITION",
        "ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
    }
    closing_roles = {
        "REDUCE_POSITION",
        "CLOSE_PARTIAL",
        "CLOSE_FULL",
        "ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
    }
    opening = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in opening_roles]
    closing = [segment for segment in ordered if segment["segment_role"] in closing_roles]
    fill_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["fill_record_id"] for segment in ordered))
    order_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(segment["order_id"] for segment in ordered))
    source_fills = [fills_by_id[fill_id] for fill_id in fill_ids]
    commission = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("commission"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    pnl = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(fill.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False)
            for fill in source_fills
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    maximum_position = max(
        (
            abs(decimal_value(segment.get("position_after"), allow_none=False))
            for segment in ordered
        ),
        default=Decimal(0),
    )
    opening_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in opening
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    closing_quantity = sum(
        (
            decimal_value(segment.get("segment_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            for segment in closing
        ),
        Decimal(0),
    )
    start = parse_time(ordered[0]["event_time_utc"])
    end = parse_time(ordered[-1]["event_time_utc"])
    warnings = list(dict.fromkeys(warning_codes))
    return {
        "position_cycle_id": cycle_id,
        "account_scope": account_scope,
        "portfolio_id_or_scope_label": account_scope,

        ),
        "add_count": sum(

        ),
        "reduce_count": sum(

        ),
        "partial_close_count": sum(

        ),

def summary_validation(
    summary: Mapping[str, Any], cycle: Mapping[str, Any]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    calculated_entry = decimal_value(cycle.get("weighted_entry_price"))
    calculated_exit = decimal_value(cycle.get("weighted_exit_price"))
    calculated_pnl = decimal_value(cycle.get("fill_realized_pnl_sum"))
    calculated_max = decimal_value(cycle.get("maximum_absolute_position"))
    calculated_close = decimal_value(cycle.get("closing_quantity_total"))
    exact_components = {
        "open_time": cycle["cycle_start_time_utc"]
        == time_text(summary["open_time"], "UTC"),
        "close_time": cycle["cycle_end_time_utc"]
        == time_text(summary["close_time"], "UTC"),
        "entry_price": calculated_entry == summary["entry_price"],
        "exit_price": calculated_exit == summary["exit_price"],
        "maximum_quantity": calculated_max == summary["maximum_quantity"],
        "closed_quantity": calculated_close == summary["closed_quantity"],
        "realized_pnl": calculated_pnl == summary["realized_pnl"],
    }
    tolerance_components = {
        "open_time": exact_components["open_time"],
        "close_time": exact_components["close_time"],
        "entry_price": approx_equal(
            calculated_entry,
            summary["entry_price"],
            display_tolerance(summary["entry_price_raw"]),
        ),
        "exit_price": approx_equal(
            calculated_exit,
            summary["exit_price"],
            display_tolerance(summary["exit_price_raw"]),
        ),
        "maximum_quantity": approx_equal(
            calculated_max,
            summary["maximum_quantity"],
            display_tolerance(summary["maximum_quantity_raw"]),
        ),
        "closed_quantity": approx_equal(
            calculated_close,
            summary["closed_quantity"],
            display_tolerance(summary["closed_quantity_raw"]),
        ),
        "realized_pnl": approx_equal(
            calculated_pnl,
            summary["realized_pnl"],
            display_tolerance(summary["realized_pnl_raw"]),
        ),
    }
    path_exact = (
        calculated_max == summary["maximum_quantity"]
        and decimal_value(cycle["opening_quantity_total"])
        == summary["closed_quantity"]
        and calculated_close == summary["closed_quantity"]
        and exact_components["open_time"]
        and exact_components["close_time"]
    )
    if all(exact_components.values()):
        status = "EXACT_MATCH"
    elif all(tolerance_components.values()):
        status = "MATCH_WITH_TOLERANCE"
    elif path_exact:
        status = "PARTIAL_MATCH"
    else:
        status = "CONFLICT"
    return {
        "summary_record_id": summary["summary_id"],
        "summary_source_record_id": summary["source_record_id"],
        "position_cycle_id": cycle["position_cycle_id"],
        "symbol": summary["symbol"],
        "position_side": summary["direction"],
        "validation_status": status,
        "summary_open_time_utc": time_text(summary["open_time"], "UTC"),
        "reconstructed_open_time_utc": cycle["cycle_start_time_utc"],
        "summary_close_time_utc": time_text(summary["close_time"], "UTC"),
        "reconstructed_close_time_utc": cycle["cycle_end_time_utc"],
        "summary_entry_price": decimal_text(summary["entry_price"]),
        "reconstructed_entry_price": cycle["weighted_entry_price"],
        "entry_price_difference": decimal_text(
            (calculated_entry or Decimal(0)) - summary["entry_price"]
        ),
        "entry_tolerance": decimal_text(display_tolerance(summary["entry_price_raw"])),
        "summary_exit_price": decimal_text(summary["exit_price"]),
        "reconstructed_exit_price": cycle["weighted_exit_price"],
        "exit_price_difference": decimal_text(
            (calculated_exit or Decimal(0)) - summary["exit_price"]
        ),
        "exit_tolerance": decimal_text(display_tolerance(summary["exit_price_raw"])),
        "summary_maximum_quantity": decimal_text(summary["maximum_quantity"]),
        "reconstructed_maximum_quantity": cycle["maximum_absolute_position"],
        "summary_closed_quantity": decimal_text(summary["closed_quantity"]),
        "reconstructed_closing_quantity": cycle["closing_quantity_total"],

    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],

    segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    cycles: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    validations: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for summary in summaries:
        cycle_id = stable_id(
            "S05-CYC",
            "NORMAL_UM_SUMMARY_SCOPE",
            summary["summary_id"],
            summary["symbol"],
            summary["direction"],
        )
        partition_key = "|".join(
            [
                "NORMAL_UM_SUMMARY_SCOPE",
                summary["symbol"],
                "HEDGE",
                summary["direction"],
            ]
        )
        position = Decimal(0)
        cycle_segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for fill, action, basis in sorted(
            summary["assignments"], key=lambda item: source_sort_key(item[0])
        ):
            quantity = decimal_value(fill.get("fill_quantity"), allow_none=False)
            before = position
            if action == "OPEN":
                after = before + quantity
                role = "OPEN_INITIAL" if before == 0 else "ADD_POSITION"
                signed = quantity
            else:
                after = before - quantity
                require(
                    after >= 0,
                    f"普通Hedge仓位出现负路径：{summary['summary_id']}",
                )
                role = "CLOSE_FULL" if after == 0 else "REDUCE_POSITION"
                signed = -quantity
            segment = make_segment(
                fill=fill,
                segment_sequence=1,
                quantity=quantity,
                signed_change=signed,
                position_before=before,
                position_after=after,
                event_role=role,
                account_scope="NORMAL_UM_SUMMARY_SCOPE",
                partition_key=partition_key,
                position_mode="HEDGE",
                position_side=summary["direction"],
                cycle_id=cycle_id,
                sequence_confidence="高",
                evidence_level="E2+E3",
                assignment_basis=basis,
            )
            segments.append(segment)
            cycle_segments.append(segment)
            position = after
        require(position == 0, f"普通摘要周期未归零：{summary['summary_id']}")
        cycle = build_cycle_record(
            cycle_id=cycle_id,
            account_scope="NORMAL_UM_SUMMARY_SCOPE",
            symbol=summary["symbol"],
            position_mode="HEDGE",
            position_side=summary["direction"],
            initial_direction=summary["direction"],

            fills_by_id=fills_by_id,

            boundary_confidence="高",
            evidence_level="E2+E3",
            summary_id=summary["summary_id"],
            summary_validation_status=None,
            warning_codes=(),
        )
        validation = summary_validation(summary, cycle)
        cycle["summary_validation_status"] = validation["validation_status"]

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,

                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def build_summary_models(position_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in position_rows:
        direction = text(row.get("position_side_standard_code"))
        require(direction in {"LONG", "SHORT"}, f"仓位摘要方向异常：{direction}")
        open_time = parse_time(row.get("open_time_utc"))
        close_time = parse_time(row.get("close_time_utc"))
        require(open_time is not None and close_time is not None, "仓位摘要时间为空")
        require(open_time <= close_time, "仓位摘要结束早于开始")
        summaries.append(
            {
                "summary_id": text(row.get("position_record_id"))
                or text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_record_id": text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_row_number": int(text(row.get("source_row_number")) or 0),
                "symbol": text(row.get("symbol_standard")),
                "direction": direction,
                "open_time": open_time,
                "close_time": close_time,
                "entry_price": decimal_value(row.get("entry_price"), allow_none=False),
                "entry_price_raw": text(row.get("entry_price")),
                "exit_price": decimal_value(row.get("exit_price"), allow_none=False),
                "exit_price_raw": text(row.get("exit_price")),
                "maximum_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("maximum_position_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "maximum_quantity_raw": text(row.get("maximum_position_quantity")),
                "closed_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("closed_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "closed_quantity_raw": text(row.get("closed_quantity")),
                "realized_pnl": decimal_value(row.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False),
                "realized_pnl_raw": text(row.get("realized_pnl")),
                "margin_mode": text(row.get("margin_mode_standard_code")),
                "position_status": text(row.get("position_status_standard_code")),
                "leverage": text(row.get("leverage")),
                "row": row,
                "assignments": [],
                "removed_order_ids": [],
            }
        )
    summaries.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            item["symbol"],
            item["open_time"],
            item["direction"],
            item["source_row_number"],
        )
    )
    return summaries

    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],

    cycles: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    validations: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for summary in summaries:
        cycle_id = stable_id(
            "S05-CYC",
            "NORMAL_UM_SUMMARY_SCOPE",
            summary["summary_id"],
            summary["symbol"],
            summary["direction"],
        )
        partition_key = "|".join(
            [
                "NORMAL_UM_SUMMARY_SCOPE",
                summary["symbol"],
                "HEDGE",
                summary["direction"],
            ]
        )
        position = Decimal(0)
        cycle_segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for fill, action, basis in sorted(
            summary["assignments"], key=lambda item: source_sort_key(item[0])
        ):
            quantity = decimal_value(fill.get("fill_quantity"), allow_none=False)

            if action == "OPEN":

                role = "OPEN_INITIAL" if before == 0 else "ADD_POSITION"

                require(
                    after >= 0,
                    f"普通Hedge仓位出现负路径：{summary['summary_id']}",
                )
                role = "CLOSE_FULL" if after == 0 else "REDUCE_POSITION"
                signed = -quantity

                fill=fill,
                segment_sequence=1,
                quantity=quantity,
                signed_change=signed,
                position_before=before,
                position_after=after,
                event_role=role,
                account_scope="NORMAL_UM_SUMMARY_SCOPE",
                partition_key=partition_key,

                position_side=summary["direction"],
                cycle_id=cycle_id,
                sequence_confidence="高",
                evidence_level="E2+E3",
                assignment_basis=basis,

            segments.append(segment)

def reconstruct_residual_cycles(
    components: Sequence[tuple[str, list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]],

    segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    cycles: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    scope_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for account_scope, component, metadata in components:
        by_symbol: collections.defaultdict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = (
            collections.defaultdict(list)
        )
        for fill in component:
            by_symbol[text(fill.get("symbol_standard")) or ""].append(fill)
        for symbol, symbol_fills in sorted(by_symbol.items()):
            partition_key = "|".join(
                [
                    account_scope,
                    symbol,
                    "UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                    "NET_CANDIDATE",
                ]
            )
            position = Decimal(0)
            active_cycle_id: str | None = None
            active_direction: str | None = None
            active_segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            cycle_sequence = 0
            for fill in sorted(symbol_fills, key=source_sort_key):
                quantity = decimal_value(fill.get("fill_quantity"), allow_none=False)
                signed = quantity if text(fill.get("side_standard_code")) == "BUY" else -quantity
                before = position
                after = before + signed
                if before == 0:
                    cycle_sequence += 1
                    active_direction = "LONG" if after > 0 else "SHORT"
                    active_cycle_id = stable_id(
                        "S05-CYC",
                        account_scope,
                        symbol,
                        cycle_sequence,
                        text(fill.get("standard_record_id")),
                    )
                    active_segments = []
                require(active_cycle_id is not None, "剩余账户范围周期ID未建立")
                if before == 0 or before * after > 0 or after == 0:
                    if before == 0:
                        role = "OPEN_INITIAL"
                    elif after == 0:
                        role = "CLOSE_FULL"
                    elif abs(after) > abs(before):
                        role = "ADD_POSITION"
                    else:
                        role = "REDUCE_POSITION"
                    segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=1,
                        quantity=quantity,
                        signed_change=signed,
                        position_before=before,
                        position_after=after,
                        event_role=role,
                        account_scope=account_scope,
                        partition_key=partition_key,
                        position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis=(
                            "普通摘要外Fill独立数量路径；原始PositionSide缺失，"
                            "单向/单侧Hedge在本区段边界等价"
                        ),
                    )
                    segments.append(segment)
                    active_segments.append(segment)
                else:
                    close_quantity = abs(before)
                    open_quantity = abs(after)
                    close_signed = -before
                    close_segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=1,
                        quantity=close_quantity,
                        signed_change=close_signed,
                        position_before=before,
                        position_after=Decimal(0),
                        event_role="ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
                        account_scope=account_scope,
                        partition_key=partition_key,
                        position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis="一条Fill穿越0；逻辑平仓片段",
                        zero_crossing=True,
                    )
                    segments.append(close_segment)
                    active_segments.append(close_segment)
                    cycles.append(
                        build_cycle_record(
                            cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                            account_scope=account_scope,
                            symbol=symbol,
                            position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                            position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                            initial_direction=active_direction or "UNRESOLVED",
                            segments=active_segments,
                            fills_by_id=fills_by_id,
                            completion_status="COMPLETE",
                            boundary_confidence="中高",
                            evidence_level="E2",
                            summary_id=None,
                            summary_validation_status="RECONSTRUCTION_ONLY",
                            warning_codes=["ACCOUNT_SCOPE_CANDIDATE"],
                        )
                    )
                    cycle_sequence += 1
                    active_direction = "LONG" if after > 0 else "SHORT"
                    active_cycle_id = stable_id(
                        "S05-CYC",
                        account_scope,
                        symbol,
                        cycle_sequence,
                        text(fill.get("standard_record_id")),
                        "REVERSE",
                    )
                    open_segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=2,
                        quantity=open_quantity,
                        signed_change=after,
                        position_before=Decimal(0),
                        position_after=after,
                        event_role="ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
                        account_scope=account_scope,
                        partition_key=partition_key,
                        position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis="一条Fill穿越0；逻辑反向开仓片段",
                        zero_crossing=True,
                    )
                    segments.append(open_segment)
                    active_segments = [open_segment]
                position = after
                if position == 0:
                    cycles.append(
                        build_cycle_record(
                            cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                            account_scope=account_scope,
                            symbol=symbol,
                            position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                            position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                            initial_direction=active_direction or "UNRESOLVED",
                            segments=active_segments,
                            fills_by_id=fills_by_id,
                            completion_status="COMPLETE",

                            evidence_level="E2",
                            summary_id=None,
                            summary_validation_status="RECONSTRUCTION_ONLY",
                            warning_codes=["ACCOUNT_SCOPE_CANDIDATE"],
                        )
                    )
                    active_cycle_id = None
                    active_direction = None
                    active_segments = []

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],

    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],

) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def build_summary_models(position_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in position_rows:
        direction = text(row.get("position_side_standard_code"))
        require(direction in {"LONG", "SHORT"}, f"仓位摘要方向异常：{direction}")
        open_time = parse_time(row.get("open_time_utc"))
        close_time = parse_time(row.get("close_time_utc"))
        require(open_time is not None and close_time is not None, "仓位摘要时间为空")
        require(open_time <= close_time, "仓位摘要结束早于开始")
        summaries.append(
            {
                "summary_id": text(row.get("position_record_id"))

                before = position

                if before == 0 or before * after > 0 or after == 0:
                    if before == 0:

                    elif after == 0:

                    )

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

        direction = text(row.get("position_side_standard_code"))

        require(open_time <= close_time, "仓位摘要结束早于开始")

                or text(row.get("standard_record_id")),

                "source_row_number": int(text(row.get("source_row_number")) or 0),

                    row.get("maximum_position_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "maximum_quantity_raw": text(row.get("maximum_position_quantity")),

                    row.get("closed_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "closed_quantity_raw": text(row.get("closed_quantity")),

summaries = build_summary_models(positions)
    annotations, isolated_overlap_fills, scope_remediation = (
        assign_fills_to_summaries(fills, summaries)
    )
    assigned_fill_ids = {
        text(fill.get("standard_record_id"))
        for summary in summaries
        for fill, _action, _basis in summary["assignments"]
    }
    residual_fills = [
        dict(fill)
        for fill in fills
        if text(fill.get("standard_record_id")) not in assigned_fill_ids
    ]
    require(
        len(assigned_fill_ids) == 8239
        and len(residual_fills) == 102
        and len(isolated_overlap_fills) == 6,
        (
            "账户范围隔离数量异常："
            f"普通={len(assigned_fill_ids)},剩余={len(residual_fills)},"
            f"摘要重叠隔离={len(isolated_overlap_fills)}"
        ),
    )
    residual_components = split_residual_scope_components(residual_fills)
    require(len(residual_components) == 2, "剩余Fill未形成2个自然账户范围候选")

    normal_segments, normal_cycles, summary_validations = (
        reconstruct_normal_cycles(summaries, fills_by_id)
    )
    residual_segments, residual_cycles, scope_rows = (
        reconstruct_residual_cycles(residual_components, fills_by_id)
    )
    segments = normal_segments + residual_segments
    cycles = sorted(
        normal_cycles + residual_cycles,
        key=lambda row: (
            parse_time(row["cycle_start_time_utc"]),
            row["account_scope"],
            row["symbol"],
            row["position_cycle_id"],
        ),
    )
    incomplete_segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    require(len(normal_cycles) == 136, "普通摘要周期数不是136")
    require(len(residual_cycles) == 12, "隔离账户范围候选周期数不是12")
    require(len(cycles) == 148, "完整仓位周期数不是148")

        "存在非COMPLETE周期但未写入不完整区段",
    )
