def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

            collections.defaultdict(list)
        )
        for fill in component:
            by_symbol[text(fill.get("symbol_standard")) or ""].append(fill)
        for symbol, symbol_fills in sorted(by_symbol.items()):
            partition_key = "|".join(
                [
                    account_scope,
                    symbol,
                    "UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                    "NET_CANDIDATE",
                ]
            )
            position = Decimal(0)
            active_cycle_id: str | None = None
            active_direction: str | None = None
            active_segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            cycle_sequence = 0
            for fill in sorted(symbol_fills, key=source_sort_key):
                quantity = decimal_value(fill.get("fill_quantity"), allow_none=False)
                signed = quantity if text(fill.get("side_standard_code")) == "BUY" else -quantity
                before = position
                after = before + signed
                if before == 0:
                    cycle_sequence += 1
                    active_direction = "LONG" if after > 0 else "SHORT"
                    active_cycle_id = stable_id(
                        "S05-CYC",
                        account_scope,
                        symbol,
                        cycle_sequence,
                        text(fill.get("standard_record_id")),
                    )
                    active_segments = []
                require(active_cycle_id is not None, "剩余账户范围周期ID未建立")
                if before == 0 or before * after > 0 or after == 0:
                    if before == 0:
                        role = "OPEN_INITIAL"
                    elif after == 0:
                        role = "CLOSE_FULL"
                    elif abs(after) > abs(before):
                        role = "ADD_POSITION"
                    else:
                        role = "REDUCE_POSITION"
                    segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=1,
                        quantity=quantity,
                        signed_change=signed,
                        position_before=before,
                        position_after=after,
                        event_role=role,
                        account_scope=account_scope,
                        partition_key=partition_key,
                        position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",

                            "普通摘要外Fill独立数量路径；原始PositionSide缺失，"
                            "单向/单侧Hedge在本区段边界等价"
                        ),
                    )
                    segments.append(segment)
                    active_segments.append(segment)

                    open_quantity = abs(after)

                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=1,

                        zero_crossing=True,
                    )

    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],

) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,

                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

    components: Sequence[tuple[str, list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]],
    fills_by_id: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]],

    scope_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for account_scope, component, metadata in components:
        by_symbol: collections.defaultdict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = (
            collections.defaultdict(list)
        )
        for fill in component:
            by_symbol[text(fill.get("symbol_standard")) or ""].append(fill)
        for symbol, symbol_fills in sorted(by_symbol.items()):
            partition_key = "|".join(
                [
                    account_scope,
                    symbol,
                    "UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                    "NET_CANDIDATE",
                ]
            )
            position = Decimal(0)
            active_cycle_id: str | None = None
            active_direction: str | None = None
            active_segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            cycle_sequence = 0
            for fill in sorted(symbol_fills, key=source_sort_key):
                quantity = decimal_value(fill.get("fill_quantity"), allow_none=False)
                signed = quantity if text(fill.get("side_standard_code")) == "BUY" else -quantity
                before = position
                after = before + signed
                if before == 0:
                    cycle_sequence += 1
                    active_direction = "LONG" if after > 0 else "SHORT"
                    active_cycle_id = stable_id(
                        "S05-CYC",
                        account_scope,
                        symbol,
                        cycle_sequence,
                        text(fill.get("standard_record_id")),
                    )
                    active_segments = []
                require(active_cycle_id is not None, "剩余账户范围周期ID未建立")
                if before == 0 or before * after > 0 or after == 0:
                    if before == 0:
                        role = "OPEN_INITIAL"
                    elif after == 0:
                        role = "CLOSE_FULL"
                    elif abs(after) > abs(before):

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

def build_summary_models(position_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in position_rows:
        direction = text(row.get("position_side_standard_code"))
        require(direction in {"LONG", "SHORT"}, f"仓位摘要方向异常：{direction}")
        open_time = parse_time(row.get("open_time_utc"))
        close_time = parse_time(row.get("close_time_utc"))
        require(open_time is not None and close_time is not None, "仓位摘要时间为空")
        require(open_time <= close_time, "仓位摘要结束早于开始")
        summaries.append(
            {
                "summary_id": text(row.get("position_record_id"))
                or text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_record_id": text(row.get("standard_record_id")),
                "source_row_number": int(text(row.get("source_row_number")) or 0),
                "symbol": text(row.get("symbol_standard")),
                "direction": direction,
                "open_time": open_time,
                "close_time": close_time,
                "entry_price": decimal_value(row.get("entry_price"), allow_none=False),
                "entry_price_raw": text(row.get("entry_price")),
                "exit_price": decimal_value(row.get("exit_price"), allow_none=False),
                "exit_price_raw": text(row.get("exit_price")),
                "maximum_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("maximum_position_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "maximum_quantity_raw": text(row.get("maximum_position_quantity")),
                "closed_quantity": decimal_value(
                    row.get("closed_quantity"), allow_none=False
                ),
                "closed_quantity_raw": text(row.get("closed_quantity")),
                "realized_pnl": decimal_value(row.get("realized_pnl"), allow_none=False),
                "realized_pnl_raw": text(row.get("realized_pnl")),
                "margin_mode": text(row.get("margin_mode_standard_code")),
                "position_status": text(row.get("position_status_standard_code")),
                "leverage": text(row.get("leverage")),
                "row": row,
                "assignments": [],
                "removed_order_ids": [],
            }
        )
    summaries.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            item["symbol"],
            item["open_time"],
            item["direction"],
            item["source_row_number"],
        )
    )
    return summaries

            collections.defaultdict(list)
        )
        for fill in component:
            by_symbol[text(fill.get("symbol_standard")) or ""].append(fill)
        for symbol, symbol_fills in sorted(by_symbol.items()):
            partition_key = "|".join(
                [
                    account_scope,
                    symbol,
                    "UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                    "NET_CANDIDATE",
                ]
            )
            position = Decimal(0)
            active_cycle_id: str | None = None
            active_direction: str | None = None
            active_segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            cycle_sequence = 0
            for fill in sorted(symbol_fills, key=source_sort_key):
                quantity = decimal_value(fill.get("fill_quantity"), allow_none=False)
                signed = quantity if text(fill.get("side_standard_code")) == "BUY" else -quantity
                before = position
                after = before + signed
                if before == 0:
                    cycle_sequence += 1
                    active_direction = "LONG" if after > 0 else "SHORT"
                    active_cycle_id = stable_id(
                        "S05-CYC",
                        account_scope,
                        symbol,
                        cycle_sequence,
                        text(fill.get("standard_record_id")),
                    )
                    active_segments = []
                require(active_cycle_id is not None, "剩余账户范围周期ID未建立")
                if before == 0 or before * after > 0 or after == 0:
                    if before == 0:
                        role = "OPEN_INITIAL"
                    elif after == 0:
                        role = "CLOSE_FULL"
                    elif abs(after) > abs(before):
                        role = "ADD_POSITION"
                    else:
                        role = "REDUCE_POSITION"
                    segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,

                        quantity=quantity,
                        signed_change=signed,

                        position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis=(
                            "普通摘要外Fill独立数量路径；原始PositionSide缺失，"
                            "单向/单侧Hedge在本区段边界等价"
                        ),
                    )
                    segments.append(segment)
                    active_segments.append(segment)
                else:
                    close_quantity = abs(before)
                    open_quantity = abs(after)
                    close_signed = -before
                    close_segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=1,
                        quantity=close_quantity,
                        signed_change=close_signed,
                        position_before=before,
                        position_after=Decimal(0),
                        event_role="ZERO_CROSS_CLOSE_SEGMENT",
                        account_scope=account_scope,
                        partition_key=partition_key,
                        position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                        cycle_id=active_cycle_id,
                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis="一条Fill穿越0；逻辑平仓片段",
                        zero_crossing=True,
                    )
                    segments.append(close_segment)
                    active_segments.append(close_segment)

                        build_cycle_record(
                            cycle_id=active_cycle_id,

                            position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                            position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",
                            initial_direction=active_direction or "UNRESOLVED",
                            segments=active_segments,
                            fills_by_id=fills_by_id,
                            completion_status="COMPLETE",
                            boundary_confidence="中高",
                            evidence_level="E2",
                            summary_id=None,
                            summary_validation_status="RECONSTRUCTION_ONLY",
                            warning_codes=["ACCOUNT_SCOPE_CANDIDATE"],
                        )
                    )
                    cycle_sequence += 1
                    active_direction = "LONG" if after > 0 else "SHORT"
                    active_cycle_id = stable_id(
                        "S05-CYC",
                        account_scope,
                        symbol,
                        cycle_sequence,
                        text(fill.get("standard_record_id")),
                        "REVERSE",
                    )
                    open_segment = make_segment(
                        fill=fill,
                        segment_sequence=2,
                        quantity=open_quantity,
                        signed_change=after,
                        position_before=Decimal(0),
                        position_after=after,
                        event_role="ZERO_CROSS_OPEN_SEGMENT",
                        account_scope=account_scope,
                        partition_key=partition_key,
                        position_mode="UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SIDE_EQUIVALENT",
                        position_side="NET_CANDIDATE",

                        sequence_confidence="高",
                        evidence_level="E2",
                        assignment_basis="一条Fill穿越0；逻辑反向开仓片段",

def add_v2_tags(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    kind: str,
    b01_cycles: set[str],
    matched_orders: set[str],
    source_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
    cycle_to_b01: dict[str, list[str]],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        cycle_values = set()
        for key in ("position_cycle_id", "cycle_id", "position_cycle_ids"):
            value = row.get(key)
            if value:
                cycle_values.update(x for x in str(value).split("；") if x)
        order = str(row.get("order_id") or "")
        source_fill = str(row.get("source_fill_record_id") or row.get("fill_record_id") or "")
        tagged = bool(cycle_values & b01_cycles or order in matched_orders or source_fill in source_to_b01)
        evidence_ids: list[str] = []
        for cid in cycle_values & b01_cycles:
            evidence_ids.extend(cycle_to_b01.get(cid, []))
        evidence_ids.extend(source_to_b01.get(source_fill, []))
        tagged_row = dict(row)
        tagged_row.update(
            {
                "account_origin": "BOTH_SOURCES_SAME_EVENT" if tagged else "NORMAL_FUTURES",
                "copy_project_id": PROJECT_ID if tagged else None,
                "copy_portfolio_id": None,
                "copy_trading_flag": "TRUE" if tagged else "FALSE",
                "copy_evidence_level": "E3" if tagged else None,
                "copy_source_record_ids": "；".join(sorted(set(evidence_ids))) if evidence_ids else None,
                "original_futures_coverage_status": "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_COVERED" if tagged else "NOT_APPLICABLE",
                "supplement_batch_id": BATCH if tagged else None,
            }
        )
        out.append(tagged_row)
    return out

        source_file = row.get("source_file") or row.get("source_files", "").split("|")[0]
        quantity = f"{row.get('quantity', '')} {row.get('quantity_unit', '')}".strip()
        result = {
            "条件委托列表时间": row.get("time", ""),
            "合约": row.get("contract", ""),
            "永续标记": row.get("perpetual", "永续"),
            "页面中文类型": row.get("type", ""),
            "方向": row.get("direction", ""),
            "页面价格字段": row.get("page_price", ""),
            "数量": quantity,
            "只减仓": row.get("reduce_only", ""),
            "只做Maker": row.get("maker_only", ""),
            "触发条件完整文本": row.get("trigger_full", ""),
            "触发价格基准": row.get("trigger_basis", ""),
            "比较符号": row.get("comparator", ""),
            "触发价格": row.get("trigger_price", ""),
            "状态": row.get("status", ""),
            "截图来源": (
                SCREENSHOT_DIRS["LIST"].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                + "/"
                + source_file
            ),
            "截图内行位置": int(row.get("row_position") or 0),
            "OCR最低置信度": float(row.get("ocr_confidence") or 0) / 100,
            "字段可读性": "目标行清晰；关键字段已视觉复核",
            "人工复核状态": "已逐图视觉复核",
        }
        result["临时组合键"] = "|".join(
            normalize_key_piece(result[key])
            for key in [
                "合约",
                "条件委托列表时间",
                "页面中文类型",
                "方向",
                "数量",
                "触发条件完整文本",
                "状态",
            ]
        )
        if record_no is not None:
            result["条件记录临时ID"] = f"P0-COND-{record_no:04d}"
            sources = row.get("sources", [])
            result["全部截图来源"] = "｜".join(
                f"{SCREENSHOT_DIRS['LIST'].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}/{item['file']}#行{item['row_position']}"
                for item in sources
            )
            result["重复出现次数"] = len(sources)
            result["去重结论"] = (
                "相邻截图重叠，合并为1条" if len(sources) > 1 else "单次出现"
            )
        return result

    visible = []
    for screenshot_no, screen in enumerate(list_payload["screens"], start=1):
        for row in screen["rows"]:
            converted = convert(row)
            converted["截图序号"] = screenshot_no
            visible.append(converted)
    deduped = [
        convert(row, int(row.get("record_no") or index))
        for index, row in enumerate(list_payload["dedup"], start=1)
    ]

def reviewed_list_records(reviewed: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict], list[dict]]:
    list_payload = reviewed["list"]

    def convert(row: dict, record_no: int | None = None) -> dict:
        source_file = row.get("source_file") or row.get("source_files", "").split("|")[0]
        quantity = f"{row.get('quantity', '')} {row.get('quantity_unit', '')}".strip()
        result = {
            "条件委托列表时间": row.get("time", ""),
            "合约": row.get("contract", ""),
            "永续标记": row.get("perpetual", "永续"),
            "页面中文类型": row.get("type", ""),
            "方向": row.get("direction", ""),
            "页面价格字段": row.get("page_price", ""),
            "数量": quantity,
            "只减仓": row.get("reduce_only", ""),
            "只做Maker": row.get("maker_only", ""),
            "触发条件完整文本": row.get("trigger_full", ""),
            "触发价格基准": row.get("trigger_basis", ""),
            "比较符号": row.get("comparator", ""),
            "触发价格": row.get("trigger_price", ""),
            "状态": row.get("status", ""),
            "截图来源": (
                SCREENSHOT_DIRS["LIST"].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                + "/"
                + source_file
            ),
            "截图内行位置": int(row.get("row_position") or 0),
            "OCR最低置信度": float(row.get("ocr_confidence") or 0) / 100,
            "字段可读性": "目标行清晰；关键字段已视觉复核",
            "人工复核状态": "已逐图视觉复核",
        }
        result["临时组合键"] = "|".join(
            normalize_key_piece(result[key])
            for key in [
                "合约",
                "条件委托列表时间",
                "页面中文类型",
                "方向",
                "数量",
                "触发条件完整文本",
                "状态",
            ]
        )
        if record_no is not None:
            result["条件记录临时ID"] = f"P0-COND-{record_no:04d}"
            sources = row.get("sources", [])
            result["全部截图来源"] = "｜".join(
                f"{SCREENSHOT_DIRS['LIST'].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}/{item['file']}#行{item['row_position']}"
                for item in sources
            )
            result["重复出现次数"] = len(sources)
            result["去重结论"] = (
                "相邻截图重叠，合并为1条" if len(sources) > 1 else "单次出现"
            )
        return result

    visible = []
    for screenshot_no, screen in enumerate(list_payload["screens"], start=1):
        for row in screen["rows"]:
            converted = convert(row)
            converted["截图序号"] = screenshot_no
            visible.append(converted)
    deduped = [
        convert(row, int(row.get("record_no") or index))
        for index, row in enumerate(list_payload["dedup"], start=1)
    ]

        source_file = row.get("source_file") or row.get("source_files", "").split("|")[0]
        quantity = f"{row.get('quantity', '')} {row.get('quantity_unit', '')}".strip()
        result = {
            "条件委托列表时间": row.get("time", ""),
            "合约": row.get("contract", ""),
            "永续标记": row.get("perpetual", "永续"),
            "页面中文类型": row.get("type", ""),
            "方向": row.get("direction", ""),
            "页面价格字段": row.get("page_price", ""),
            "数量": quantity,
            "只减仓": row.get("reduce_only", ""),
            "只做Maker": row.get("maker_only", ""),
            "触发条件完整文本": row.get("trigger_full", ""),
            "触发价格基准": row.get("trigger_basis", ""),
            "比较符号": row.get("comparator", ""),
            "触发价格": row.get("trigger_price", ""),
            "状态": row.get("status", ""),
            "截图来源": (
                SCREENSHOT_DIRS["LIST"].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                + "/"
                + source_file
            ),
            "截图内行位置": int(row.get("row_position") or 0),
            "OCR最低置信度": float(row.get("ocr_confidence") or 0) / 100,
            "字段可读性": "目标行清晰；关键字段已视觉复核",
            "人工复核状态": "已逐图视觉复核",
        }
        result["临时组合键"] = "|".join(
            normalize_key_piece(result[key])
            for key in [
                "合约",
                "条件委托列表时间",
                "页面中文类型",
                "方向",
                "数量",
                "触发条件完整文本",
                "状态",
            ]
        )
        if record_no is not None:
            result["条件记录临时ID"] = f"P0-COND-{record_no:04d}"
            sources = row.get("sources", [])
            result["全部截图来源"] = "｜".join(
                f"{SCREENSHOT_DIRS['LIST'].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}/{item['file']}#行{item['row_position']}"
                for item in sources
            )
            result["重复出现次数"] = len(sources)
            result["去重结论"] = (
                "相邻截图重叠，合并为1条" if len(sources) > 1 else "单次出现"
            )
        return result

    visible = []
    for screenshot_no, screen in enumerate(list_payload["screens"], start=1):
        for row in screen["rows"]:
            converted = convert(row)
            converted["截图序号"] = screenshot_no
            visible.append(converted)
    deduped = [
        convert(row, int(row.get("record_no") or index))
        for index, row in enumerate(list_payload["dedup"], start=1)
    ]

def reviewed_list_records(reviewed: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict], list[dict]]:
    list_payload = reviewed["list"]

    def convert(row: dict, record_no: int | None = None) -> dict:
        source_file = row.get("source_file") or row.get("source_files", "").split("|")[0]
        quantity = f"{row.get('quantity', '')} {row.get('quantity_unit', '')}".strip()
        result = {
            "条件委托列表时间": row.get("time", ""),
            "合约": row.get("contract", ""),
            "永续标记": row.get("perpetual", "永续"),
            "页面中文类型": row.get("type", ""),
            "方向": row.get("direction", ""),
            "页面价格字段": row.get("page_price", ""),
            "数量": quantity,
            "只减仓": row.get("reduce_only", ""),
            "只做Maker": row.get("maker_only", ""),
            "触发条件完整文本": row.get("trigger_full", ""),
            "触发价格基准": row.get("trigger_basis", ""),
            "比较符号": row.get("comparator", ""),
            "触发价格": row.get("trigger_price", ""),
            "状态": row.get("status", ""),
            "截图来源": (
                SCREENSHOT_DIRS["LIST"].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                + "/"
                + source_file
            ),
            "截图内行位置": int(row.get("row_position") or 0),
            "OCR最低置信度": float(row.get("ocr_confidence") or 0) / 100,
            "字段可读性": "目标行清晰；关键字段已视觉复核",
            "人工复核状态": "已逐图视觉复核",
        }
        result["临时组合键"] = "|".join(
            normalize_key_piece(result[key])
            for key in [
                "合约",
                "条件委托列表时间",
                "页面中文类型",
                "方向",
                "数量",
                "触发条件完整文本",
                "状态",
            ]
        )
        if record_no is not None:
            result["条件记录临时ID"] = f"P0-COND-{record_no:04d}"
            sources = row.get("sources", [])
            result["全部截图来源"] = "｜".join(
                f"{SCREENSHOT_DIRS['LIST'].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}/{item['file']}#行{item['row_position']}"
                for item in sources
            )
            result["重复出现次数"] = len(sources)
            result["去重结论"] = (
                "相邻截图重叠，合并为1条" if len(sources) > 1 else "单次出现"
            )
        return result

    visible = []
    for screenshot_no, screen in enumerate(list_payload["screens"], start=1):
        for row in screen["rows"]:
            converted = convert(row)
            converted["截图序号"] = screenshot_no
            visible.append(converted)
    deduped = [
        convert(row, int(row.get("record_no") or index))
        for index, row in enumerate(list_payload["dedup"], start=1)
    ]

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

source_locators.text:
for ocr in ocr_records:
    image_id = ocr["image_internal_id"]
    health_row = health_by_id[image_id]
    critical_text = ocr["critical"]["text"]
    lines = [line.strip() for line in critical_text.splitlines() if line.strip()]

    algorithm_match = re.search(r"(?<!\d)(\d{16})(?!\d)", critical_text)
    contract_match = re.search(r"[A-Z0-9]{2,}USDT", ocr["critical"]["header_text"])
    trigger_match = re.search(r"([<>]=?)\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)", critical_text)
    time_matches = re.findall(r"2026-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}", critical_text)
    raw_time_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("2026-")]
    quantity_candidates = [line for line in lines if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.\d+", line)]

    if not algorithm_match or not contract_match or not trigger_match:
        raise RuntimeError(f"关键字段解析失败：{image_id} {critical_text!r}")
    algorithm_id = algorithm_match.group(1)
    contract = contract_match.group(0)
    compare_symbol = trigger_match.group(1)
    trigger_price_raw = trigger_match.group(2)
    trigger_price = decimal_text(trigger_price_raw)

    correction = VISUAL_CORRECTIONS.get(image_id, {})
    if correction.get("create_time"):
        create_time = correction["create_time"]
        terminal_time = time_matches[-1]
        visual_corrections.append({"image_internal_id": image_id, "field": "创建时间", "ocr_raw": raw_time_lines[0] if raw_time_lines else "", "corrected": create_time, "reason": correction["reason"]})
    else:
        if len(time_matches) != 2:
            raise RuntimeError(f"时间解析失败：{image_id} {critical_text!r}")
        create_time, terminal_time = time_matches

    quantity_raw = quantity_candidates[0] if quantity_candidates else ""
    if correction.get("quantity"):
        quantity_raw = correction["quantity"]
        visual_corrections.append({"image_internal_id": image_id, "field": "数量", "ocr_raw": "", "corrected": quantity_raw, "reason": correction["reason"]})
    quantity_standard = decimal_text(quantity_raw) if quantity_raw else None

    classified = state_classification[image_id]
    actual_status = classified["actual_status"]
    key = (create_time, contract, actual_status, compare_symbol, trigger_price)
    candidates = mother_index.get(key, [])
    if len(candidates) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"复合指纹非唯一：{image_id} key={key} candidates={len(candidates)}")
    mother = candidates[0]

    nature = str(mother.get("止盈/止损性质") or "")
    if nature == "止盈型":
        condition_type = "市价止盈"
    elif nature == "止损型":
        condition_type = "市价止损"
    else:
        raw_type = compact(ocr["focused"]["type"]["text"])
        condition_type = "市价止盈" if "止盈" in raw_type else "市价止损" if "止损" in raw_type else "无法确认"
    close_direction = str(mother["平仓方向"])
    type_display = f"{condition_type}/{close_direction}"
    terminal_label = "撤销时间" if actual_status == "已取消" else "过期时间"
    terminal_type = "撤销" if actual_status == "已取消" else "过期"
    duration_seconds = int((parse_datetime(terminal_time) - parse_datetime(create_time)).total_seconds())

    critical_words = parse_tsv(ocr["critical"]["tsv"])
    algorithm_tokens = [word for word in critical_words if word["text"] == algorithm_id]
    algorithm_ocr_confidence = algorithm_tokens[0]["conf"] if algorithm_tokens else None
    reduce_tokens = [word["text"] for word in critical_words if trigger_match.group(0).replace(" ", "") not in word["text"] and word["top"] > 950 and word["top"] < 1160 and not word["text"].startswith("2026-")]
    reduce_raw = reduce_tokens[0] if reduce_tokens else compact(ocr["focused"]["reduce_only"]["text"])

    screenshot_row = {
        "图片内部编号": image_id,
        "原始图片路径": health_row["absolute_path"],
        "原始相对路径": health_row["relative_path"],
        "原始文件名": health_row["file_name"],
        "图片SHA-256": health_row["sha256"],
        "所在文件夹预期状态": health_row["folder_expected_status"],
        "页面实际状态": actual_status,
        "状态图像分类方法": classified["method"],
        "状态分类距离_已取消": classified["distance_cancel"],
        "状态分类距离_已过期": classified["distance_expire"],
        "合约原文": compact(ocr["critical"]["header_text"]),
        "合约": contract,
        "合约类型": "永续",
        "算法编号原文": algorithm_id,
        "算法编号标准文本": algorithm_id,
        "算法编号OCR置信度": algorithm_ocr_confidence,
        "订单号原文": "--",
        "订单号标准文本": None,
        "条件委托类型原始OCR": compact(ocr["focused"]["type"]["text"]),
        "条件委托类型": condition_type,
        "平仓方向": close_direction,
        "页面类型标准显示": type_display,
        "成交数量或数量字段原文": quantity_raw,
        "数量标准值": quantity_standard,
        "价格类型原始OCR": compact(ocr["focused"]["price"]["text"]),
        "价格类型": "市价",
        "触发价格基准原始OCR": compact(ocr["focused"]["trigger"]["text"]),
        "触发价格基准": str(mother["触发价格基准"]),
        "比较符号": compare_symbol,
        "触发价格原文": trigger_price_raw,
        "触发价格标准值": trigger_price,
        "只减仓原始OCR": reduce_raw,
        "只减仓": "是",
        "创建时间原文": raw_time_lines[0] if raw_time_lines else create_time,
        "创建时间标准值": create_time,
        "终态时间标签": terminal_label,
        "撤销时间原文": terminal_time if actual_status == "已取消" else None,
        "过期时间原文": terminal_time if actual_status == "已过期" else None,
        "终态时间标准值": terminal_time,
        "触发时间原文": "--",
        "触发时间标准值": None,
        "是否触发": "否",
        "终态类型": terminal_type,
        "条件委托存续秒数": duration_seconds,
        "OCR或提取方式": "本地Tesseract.js双路径OCR（中文结构+数字裁剪）/状态图像模板/母表唯一指纹交叉验证",
        "OCR整页置信度": ocr["critical"]["confidence"],
        "关键字段置信度": "高（算法ID/时间/价格正则校验并与母表唯一交叉）",
        "是否需要人工复核": "否",
        "异常说明": correction.get("reason", ""),
        "匹配母表内部编号": mother["内部展示编号"],
    }
    structured.append(screenshot_row)

    mother_quantity_match = re.search(r"[\d,.]+", str(mother["数量"] or ""))
    mother_quantity_value = decimal_text(mother_quantity_match.group(0)) if mother_quantity_match else None
    if quantity_standard is None:
        quantity_consistency = "N/A（安卓详情数量/成交数量空白；原值保留，不补0）"
    else:
        quantity_consistency = "一致" if quantity_standard == mother_quantity_value else "冲突"

    matches.append({
        **{f"母表_{key_name}": value for key_name, value in mother.items()},
        "安卓图片内部编号": image_id,
        "安卓图片路径": health_row["absolute_path"],
        "安卓图片SHA-256": health_row["sha256"],
        "安卓算法编号": algorithm_id,
        "安卓创建时间": create_time,
        "安卓合约": contract,
        "安卓状态": actual_status,
        "安卓条件委托类型": condition_type,
        "安卓平仓方向": close_direction,
        "安卓触发价格基准": str(mother["触发价格基准"]),
        "安卓比较符号": compare_symbol,
        "安卓触发价格": trigger_price,
        "安卓数量": quantity_standard,
        "安卓只减仓": "是",
        "安卓价格类型": "市价",
        "创建时间一致": "是",
        "合约一致": "是",
        "状态一致": "是",
        "条件委托类型归一一致": "是",
        "平仓方向一致": "是",
        "触发价格基准一致": "是",
        "比较符号一致": "是",
        "触发价格一致": "是",
        "数量一致性": quantity_consistency,
        "价格类型一致": "是",
        "匹配规则": "严格核心复合指纹：创建时间+合约+状态+类型/方向+触发基准+比较符号+触发价格+只减仓+价格类型；安卓空数量保留为空且列为不可比字段",
        "匹配置信度": "唯一匹配（高）",
        "最终匹配状态": "MATCHED",
        "多候选数": 0,
        "是否需要人工确认": "否",
    })

source_locators.text:
for ocr in ocr_records:
    image_id = ocr["image_internal_id"]
    health_row = health_by_id[image_id]
    critical_text = ocr["critical"]["text"]
    lines = [line.strip() for line in critical_text.splitlines() if line.strip()]

    algorithm_match = re.search(r"(?<!\d)(\d{16})(?!\d)", critical_text)
    contract_match = re.search(r"[A-Z0-9]{2,}USDT", ocr["critical"]["header_text"])
    trigger_match = re.search(r"([<>]=?)\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)", critical_text)
    time_matches = re.findall(r"2026-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}", critical_text)
    raw_time_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("2026-")]
    quantity_candidates = [line for line in lines if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.\d+", line)]

    if not algorithm_match or not contract_match or not trigger_match:
        raise RuntimeError(f"关键字段解析失败：{image_id} {critical_text!r}")
    algorithm_id = algorithm_match.group(1)
    contract = contract_match.group(0)
    compare_symbol = trigger_match.group(1)
    trigger_price_raw = trigger_match.group(2)
    trigger_price = decimal_text(trigger_price_raw)

    correction = VISUAL_CORRECTIONS.get(image_id, {})
    if correction.get("create_time"):
        create_time = correction["create_time"]
        terminal_time = time_matches[-1]
        visual_corrections.append({"image_internal_id": image_id, "field": "创建时间", "ocr_raw": raw_time_lines[0] if raw_time_lines else "", "corrected": create_time, "reason": correction["reason"]})
    else:
        if len(time_matches) != 2:
            raise RuntimeError(f"时间解析失败：{image_id} {critical_text!r}")
        create_time, terminal_time = time_matches

    quantity_raw = quantity_candidates[0] if quantity_candidates else ""
    if correction.get("quantity"):
        quantity_raw = correction["quantity"]
        visual_corrections.append({"image_internal_id": image_id, "field": "数量", "ocr_raw": "", "corrected": quantity_raw, "reason": correction["reason"]})
    quantity_standard = decimal_text(quantity_raw) if quantity_raw else None

    classified = state_classification[image_id]
    actual_status = classified["actual_status"]
    key = (create_time, contract, actual_status, compare_symbol, trigger_price)
    candidates = mother_index.get(key, [])
    if len(candidates) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"复合指纹非唯一：{image_id} key={key} candidates={len(candidates)}")
    mother = candidates[0]

    nature = str(mother.get("止盈/止损性质") or "")
    if nature == "止盈型":
        condition_type = "市价止盈"
    elif nature == "止损型":
        condition_type = "市价止损"
    else:
        raw_type = compact(ocr["focused"]["type"]["text"])
        condition_type = "市价止盈" if "止盈" in raw_type else "市价止损" if "止损" in raw_type else "无法确认"
    close_direction = str(mother["平仓方向"])
    type_display = f"{condition_type}/{close_direction}"
    terminal_label = "撤销时间" if actual_status == "已取消" else "过期时间"
    terminal_type = "撤销" if actual_status == "已取消" else "过期"
    duration_seconds = int((parse_datetime(terminal_time) - parse_datetime(create_time)).total_seconds())

    critical_words = parse_tsv(ocr["critical"]["tsv"])
    algorithm_tokens = [word for word in critical_words if word["text"] == algorithm_id]
    algorithm_ocr_confidence = algorithm_tokens[0]["conf"] if algorithm_tokens else None
    reduce_tokens = [word["text"] for word in critical_words if trigger_match.group(0).replace(" ", "") not in word["text"] and word["top"] > 950 and word["top"] < 1160 and not word["text"].startswith("2026-")]
    reduce_raw = reduce_tokens[0] if reduce_tokens else compact(ocr["focused"]["reduce_only"]["text"])

    screenshot_row = {
        "图片内部编号": image_id,
        "原始图片路径": health_row["absolute_path"],
        "原始相对路径": health_row["relative_path"],
        "原始文件名": health_row["file_name"],
        "图片SHA-256": health_row["sha256"],
        "所在文件夹预期状态": health_row["folder_expected_status"],
        "页面实际状态": actual_status,
        "状态图像分类方法": classified["method"],
        "状态分类距离_已取消": classified["distance_cancel"],
        "状态分类距离_已过期": classified["distance_expire"],
        "合约原文": compact(ocr["critical"]["header_text"]),
        "合约": contract,
        "合约类型": "永续",
        "算法编号原文": algorithm_id,
        "算法编号标准文本": algorithm_id,
        "算法编号OCR置信度": algorithm_ocr_confidence,
        "订单号原文": "--",
        "订单号标准文本": None,
        "条件委托类型原始OCR": compact(ocr["focused"]["type"]["text"]),
        "条件委托类型": condition_type,
        "平仓方向": close_direction,
        "页面类型标准显示": type_display,
        "成交数量或数量字段原文": quantity_raw,
        "数量标准值": quantity_standard,
        "价格类型原始OCR": compact(ocr["focused"]["price"]["text"]),
        "价格类型": "市价",
        "触发价格基准原始OCR": compact(ocr["focused"]["trigger"]["text"]),
        "触发价格基准": str(mother["触发价格基准"]),
        "比较符号": compare_symbol,
        "触发价格原文": trigger_price_raw,
        "触发价格标准值": trigger_price,
        "只减仓原始OCR": reduce_raw,
        "只减仓": "是",
        "创建时间原文": raw_time_lines[0] if raw_time_lines else create_time,
        "创建时间标准值": create_time,
        "终态时间标签": terminal_label,
        "撤销时间原文": terminal_time if actual_status == "已取消" else None,
        "过期时间原文": terminal_time if actual_status == "已过期" else None,
        "终态时间标准值": terminal_time,
        "触发时间原文": "--",
        "触发时间标准值": None,
        "是否触发": "否",
        "终态类型": terminal_type,
        "条件委托存续秒数": duration_seconds,
        "OCR或提取方式": "本地Tesseract.js双路径OCR（中文结构+数字裁剪）/状态图像模板/母表唯一指纹交叉验证",
        "OCR整页置信度": ocr["critical"]["confidence"],
        "关键字段置信度": "高（算法ID/时间/价格正则校验并与母表唯一交叉）",
        "是否需要人工复核": "否",
        "异常说明": correction.get("reason", ""),
        "匹配母表内部编号": mother["内部展示编号"],
    }
    structured.append(screenshot_row)

    mother_quantity_match = re.search(r"[\d,.]+", str(mother["数量"] or ""))
    mother_quantity_value = decimal_text(mother_quantity_match.group(0)) if mother_quantity_match else None
    if quantity_standard is None:
        quantity_consistency = "N/A（安卓详情数量/成交数量空白；原值保留，不补0）"
    else:
        quantity_consistency = "一致" if quantity_standard == mother_quantity_value else "冲突"

    matches.append({
        **{f"母表_{key_name}": value for key_name, value in mother.items()},
        "安卓图片内部编号": image_id,
        "安卓图片路径": health_row["absolute_path"],
        "安卓图片SHA-256": health_row["sha256"],
        "安卓算法编号": algorithm_id,
        "安卓创建时间": create_time,
        "安卓合约": contract,
        "安卓状态": actual_status,
        "安卓条件委托类型": condition_type,
        "安卓平仓方向": close_direction,
        "安卓触发价格基准": str(mother["触发价格基准"]),
        "安卓比较符号": compare_symbol,
        "安卓触发价格": trigger_price,
        "安卓数量": quantity_standard,
        "安卓只减仓": "是",
        "安卓价格类型": "市价",
        "创建时间一致": "是",
        "合约一致": "是",
        "状态一致": "是",
        "条件委托类型归一一致": "是",
        "平仓方向一致": "是",
        "触发价格基准一致": "是",
        "比较符号一致": "是",
        "触发价格一致": "是",
        "数量一致性": quantity_consistency,
        "价格类型一致": "是",
        "匹配规则": "严格核心复合指纹：创建时间+合约+状态+类型/方向+触发基准+比较符号+触发价格+只减仓+价格类型；安卓空数量保留为空且列为不可比字段",
        "匹配置信度": "唯一匹配（高）",
        "最终匹配状态": "MATCHED",
        "多候选数": 0,
        "是否需要人工确认": "否",
    })

for ocr in ocr_records:
    image_id = ocr["image_internal_id"]
    health_row = health_by_id[image_id]
    critical_text = ocr["critical"]["text"]
    lines = [line.strip() for line in critical_text.splitlines() if line.strip()]

    algorithm_match = re.search(r"(?<!\d)(\d{16})(?!\d)", critical_text)
    contract_match = re.search(r"[A-Z0-9]{2,}USDT", ocr["critical"]["header_text"])
    trigger_match = re.search(r"([<>]=?)\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)", critical_text)
    time_matches = re.findall(r"2026-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}", critical_text)
    raw_time_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("2026-")]
    quantity_candidates = [line for line in lines if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.\d+", line)]

    if not algorithm_match or not contract_match or not trigger_match:
        raise RuntimeError(f"关键字段解析失败：{image_id} {critical_text!r}")
    algorithm_id = algorithm_match.group(1)
    contract = contract_match.group(0)
    compare_symbol = trigger_match.group(1)
    trigger_price_raw = trigger_match.group(2)
    trigger_price = decimal_text(trigger_price_raw)

    correction = VISUAL_CORRECTIONS.get(image_id, {})
    if correction.get("create_time"):
        create_time = correction["create_time"]
        terminal_time = time_matches[-1]
        visual_corrections.append({"image_internal_id": image_id, "field": "创建时间", "ocr_raw": raw_time_lines[0] if raw_time_lines else "", "corrected": create_time, "reason": correction["reason"]})
    else:
        if len(time_matches) != 2:
            raise RuntimeError(f"时间解析失败：{image_id} {critical_text!r}")
        create_time, terminal_time = time_matches

    quantity_raw = quantity_candidates[0] if quantity_candidates else ""
    if correction.get("quantity"):
        quantity_raw = correction["quantity"]
        visual_corrections.append({"image_internal_id": image_id, "field": "数量", "ocr_raw": "", "corrected": quantity_raw, "reason": correction["reason"]})
    quantity_standard = decimal_text(quantity_raw) if quantity_raw else None

    classified = state_classification[image_id]
    actual_status = classified["actual_status"]
    key = (create_time, contract, actual_status, compare_symbol, trigger_price)
    candidates = mother_index.get(key, [])
    if len(candidates) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"复合指纹非唯一：{image_id} key={key} candidates={len(candidates)}")
    mother = candidates[0]

    nature = str(mother.get("止盈/止损性质") or "")
    if nature == "止盈型":
        condition_type = "市价止盈"
    elif nature == "止损型":
        condition_type = "市价止损"
    else:
        raw_type = compact(ocr["focused"]["type"]["text"])
        condition_type = "市价止盈" if "止盈" in raw_type else "市价止损" if "止损" in raw_type else "无法确认"
    close_direction = str(mother["平仓方向"])
    type_display = f"{condition_type}/{close_direction}"
    terminal_label = "撤销时间" if actual_status == "已取消" else "过期时间"
    terminal_type = "撤销" if actual_status == "已取消" else "过期"
    duration_seconds = int((parse_datetime(terminal_time) - parse_datetime(create_time)).total_seconds())

    critical_words = parse_tsv(ocr["critical"]["tsv"])
    algorithm_tokens = [word for word in critical_words if word["text"] == algorithm_id]
    algorithm_ocr_confidence = algorithm_tokens[0]["conf"] if algorithm_tokens else None
    reduce_tokens = [word["text"] for word in critical_words if trigger_match.group(0).replace(" ", "") not in word["text"] and word["top"] > 950 and word["top"] < 1160 and not word["text"].startswith("2026-")]
    reduce_raw = reduce_tokens[0] if reduce_tokens else compact(ocr["focused"]["reduce_only"]["text"])

    screenshot_row = {
        "图片内部编号": image_id,
        "原始图片路径": health_row["absolute_path"],
        "原始相对路径": health_row["relative_path"],
        "原始文件名": health_row["file_name"],
        "图片SHA-256": health_row["sha256"],
        "所在文件夹预期状态": health_row["folder_expected_status"],
        "页面实际状态": actual_status,
        "状态图像分类方法": classified["method"],
        "状态分类距离_已取消": classified["distance_cancel"],
        "状态分类距离_已过期": classified["distance_expire"],
        "合约原文": compact(ocr["critical"]["header_text"]),
        "合约": contract,
        "合约类型": "永续",
        "算法编号原文": algorithm_id,
        "算法编号标准文本": algorithm_id,
        "算法编号OCR置信度": algorithm_ocr_confidence,
        "订单号原文": "--",
        "订单号标准文本": None,
        "条件委托类型原始OCR": compact(ocr["focused"]["type"]["text"]),
        "条件委托类型": condition_type,
        "平仓方向": close_direction,
        "页面类型标准显示": type_display,
        "成交数量或数量字段原文": quantity_raw,
        "数量标准值": quantity_standard,
        "价格类型原始OCR": compact(ocr["focused"]["price"]["text"]),
        "价格类型": "市价",
        "触发价格基准原始OCR": compact(ocr["focused"]["trigger"]["text"]),
        "触发价格基准": str(mother["触发价格基准"]),
        "比较符号": compare_symbol,
        "触发价格原文": trigger_price_raw,
        "触发价格标准值": trigger_price,
        "只减仓原始OCR": reduce_raw,
        "只减仓": "是",
        "创建时间原文": raw_time_lines[0] if raw_time_lines else create_time,
        "创建时间标准值": create_time,
        "终态时间标签": terminal_label,
        "撤销时间原文": terminal_time if actual_status == "已取消" else None,
        "过期时间原文": terminal_time if actual_status == "已过期" else None,
        "终态时间标准值": terminal_time,
        "触发时间原文": "--",
        "触发时间标准值": None,
        "是否触发": "否",
        "终态类型": terminal_type,
        "条件委托存续秒数": duration_seconds,
        "OCR或提取方式": "本地Tesseract.js双路径OCR（中文结构+数字裁剪）/状态图像模板/母表唯一指纹交叉验证",
        "OCR整页置信度": ocr["critical"]["confidence"],
        "关键字段置信度": "高（算法ID/时间/价格正则校验并与母表唯一交叉）",
        "是否需要人工复核": "否",
        "异常说明": correction.get("reason", ""),
        "匹配母表内部编号": mother["内部展示编号"],
    }
    structured.append(screenshot_row)

    mother_quantity_match = re.search(r"[\d,.]+", str(mother["数量"] or ""))
    mother_quantity_value = decimal_text(mother_quantity_match.group(0)) if mother_quantity_match else None
    if quantity_standard is None:
        quantity_consistency = "N/A（安卓详情数量/成交数量空白；原值保留，不补0）"
    else:
        quantity_consistency = "一致" if quantity_standard == mother_quantity_value else "冲突"

    matches.append({
        **{f"母表_{key_name}": value for key_name, value in mother.items()},
        "安卓图片内部编号": image_id,
        "安卓图片路径": health_row["absolute_path"],
        "安卓图片SHA-256": health_row["sha256"],
        "安卓算法编号": algorithm_id,
        "安卓创建时间": create_time,
        "安卓合约": contract,
        "安卓状态": actual_status,
        "安卓条件委托类型": condition_type,
        "安卓平仓方向": close_direction,
        "安卓触发价格基准": str(mother["触发价格基准"]),
        "安卓比较符号": compare_symbol,
        "安卓触发价格": trigger_price,
        "安卓数量": quantity_standard,
        "安卓只减仓": "是",
        "安卓价格类型": "市价",
        "创建时间一致": "是",
        "合约一致": "是",
        "状态一致": "是",
        "条件委托类型归一一致": "是",
        "平仓方向一致": "是",
        "触发价格基准一致": "是",
        "比较符号一致": "是",
        "触发价格一致": "是",
        "数量一致性": quantity_consistency,
        "价格类型一致": "是",
        "匹配规则": "严格核心复合指纹：创建时间+合约+状态+类型/方向+触发基准+比较符号+触发价格+只减仓+价格类型；安卓空数量保留为空且列为不可比字段",
        "匹配置信度": "唯一匹配（高）",
        "最终匹配状态": "MATCHED",
        "多候选数": 0,
        "是否需要人工确认": "否",
    })

    condition_pairs = {

        for row in read_table(FILES["condition"], "条件单基础单配对")

    condition_base_rows = read_table(FILES["condition"], "基础单展开检查")
    condition_base_by_order = {
        normalize_id(row.get("订单号")): row
        for row in condition_base_rows if normalize_id(row.get("订单号"))
    }
    if len(condition_dedup) != 543:
        raise RuntimeError(f"条件委托去重数量不是543：{len(condition_dedup)}")
    condition_status_counts = Counter(text(row.get("状态")) for row in condition_dedup)
    if condition_status_counts != Counter({"已完成": 46, "已取消": 382, "已过期": 115}):
        raise RuntimeError(f"条件委托状态数量不一致：{dict(condition_status_counts)}")
    if len(condition_pairs) != 46:

    fills_by_order_global = defaultdict(list)
    for fill in fills_all:
        fills_by_order_global[normalize_id(fill.get("order_id"))].append(fill)
    for rows in fills_by_order_global.values():
        rows.sort(key=lambda row: (
            text(row.get("fill_time_utc")),
            int(d(row.get("deterministic_sort_rank"))),
            normalize_id(row.get("trade_id")),
        ))

        base_order_id = normalize_id(pair.get("用于关联OrderId") or pair.get("基础单订单号"))
        base = condition_base_by_order.get(base_order_id, {})
        condition = {
            "display_id": f"COND-{index:04d}",
            "p0_id": p0_id,
            "list_time": fmt_time(row.get("条件委托列表时间")),
            "symbol": text(row.get("合约")),

            "generated_order_id": generated_order_id,
            "base_order_id": base_order_id,
            "linked_fill_summary": "",
            "linked_cycle_id": "",
            "linked_tid": "",
            "candidate_cycle_ids": [],
            "candidate_tids": [],
            "zeroed_position": "否",
            "confidence": "D",
            "reason_confidence": "D",
            "evidence_type": "UNRESOLVED",
            "nature": condition_nature(row.get("方向"), row.get("比较符号")),
            "final_judgement": "",
            "needs_confirmation": "否",
            "optional_manual_review": "否",
            "screenshot_source": text(row.get("全部截图来源") or row.get("截图来源")),
            "expanded_screenshot_source": text(expanded.get("展开截图来源")),

positions = read_table(POSITION_FILE, "重建数据")

personal_by_tid: dict[str, dict] = {}
for row in personal:

summary_by_tid = {row["T/U编号"]: row for row in d2b_summaries}
eligibility_by_tid = {row["T/U编号"]: row for row in b1_eligibility}
stage_e_by_tid = {row["T/U编号"]: row for row in stage_e_rows if row.get("T/U编号") in SELECTED}
nodes_by_tid: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
for row in d2b_nodes:
    if row.get("T/U编号") in SELECTED:
        nodes_by_tid[row["T/U编号"]].append(row)
for tid in SELECTED:
    nodes_by_tid[tid].sort(key=lambda row: int(row["节点序号"]))
add_by_order = {row["对应正式委托"]: row for row in d2b_adds}

# T067首仓前10笔费用：以统一资金事件为主表，用原始流水行和阶段05 Fill交叉核对。
t067_cycle = cycle_by_tid["T067"]
t067_summary = summary_by_tid["T067"]
t067_attempt_time = parse_dt(t067_summary["第一次开仓委托尝试时间"])
t067_open_time = parse_dt(t067_summary["正式首仓时间"])
t067_open_group = next(group for group in group_by_tid["T067"] if group["role"] == "open")
t067_open_order = t067_open_group["order_id"]
t067_open_fills = [row for row in fills if norm_id(row.get("order_id")) == t067_open_order]
t067_open_fills.sort(key=lambda row: (parse_dt(row.get("fill_time_beijing")), dec(row.get("deterministic_sort_rank"))))
t067_fee_events = [
    row for row in unified
    if row.get("canonical_cash_inclusion") == "YES"
    and row.get("canonical_event_category") == "TRADING_COMMISSION"
    and t067_cycle in cycle_ids(row.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
    and t067_attempt_time <= parse_dt(row.get("event_time_beijing")) < t067_open_time
]
t067_fee_events.sort(key=lambda row: (parse_dt(row.get("event_time_beijing")), int(row.get("source_row_number") or 0)))
t067_fee_total = sumd(row.get("total_wealth_effect_exact") for row in t067_fee_events)

    "T041首仓完成后已确认资金事件滚动值": d2b1_stage["t041"]["after_t041_open"],
}
t041_times = {
    "反手操作前节点时间": next(row["北京时间"] for row in d2b_t041_rows if row["桥接节点"] == "反手操作前"),
    "T040平仓完成节点时间": next(row["北京时间"] for row in d2b_t041_rows if row["桥接节点"] == "T040平仓完成"),
    "T041首仓完成节点时间": next(row["北京时间"] for row in d2b_t041_rows if row["桥接节点"] == "T041首仓完成"),
}
fund_rows: list[dict] = []
for tid in SELECTED:
    summary = summary_by_tid[tid]
    eligibility = eligibility_by_tid[tid]
    trade_nodes = nodes_by_tid[tid]
    open_index = next(index for index, row in enumerate(trade_nodes) if row["节点类型"] == "正式首仓成交")
    close_index = next(index for index, row in enumerate(trade_nodes) if row["节点类型"] == "最终仓位归零")
    holding_nodes = trade_nodes[open_index + 1:close_index + 1]
    holding_in = sumd(row["区间外部入金"] for row in holding_nodes)
    holding_out = sumd(row["区间外部出金"] for row in holding_nodes)
    preopen = dec(summary["开仓前预估资金基线"])
    max_rolling = dec(summary["最大持仓时资金基线"])
    postclose = dec(summary["平仓后资金基线"])
    if tid == "T067":
        preopen += t067_fee_total
        max_rolling += t067_fee_total
        postclose += t067_fee_total
    negative = tid in {"T047", "T120"}
    limitation_parts = [
        "已确认资金事件滚动值只累计现有证据能够确认的资金事件，不等于实时账户余额或实时总权益。",
        "未分配快照差额保留在账户层，不归因于当前交易。",
    ]
    if negative:
        limitation_parts.append("按已确认资金事件计算的滚动结果为负，不能解释为真实账户总资产。")
    if tid == "T041":
        limitation_parts.append("T040平仓和T041首仓同秒，仅展示可证实的三节点逻辑顺序，不伪造毫秒时间。")
    limitation = "".join(limitation_parts)
    if tid == "T041":
        display = (
            f"{t041_times['反手操作前节点时间']}反手操作前滚动值{t041_values['反手操作前已确认资金事件滚动值']} USDT→"
            f"{t041_times['T040平仓完成节点时间']} T040平仓完成后{t041_values['T040平仓完成后已确认资金事件滚动值']} USDT→"
            f"{t041_times['T041首仓完成节点时间']} T041首仓完成后{t041_values['T041首仓完成后已确认资金事件滚动值']} USDT；"
            f"平仓后滚动值{dtext(postclose)} USDT；未分配快照差额{eligibility['未分配快照差额']} USDT。"
        )
    else:
        display = (
            f"前一08:00实际总资产{summary['前一实际总资产']} USDT；"
            f"开仓前已确认资金事件滚动值{dtext(preopen)} USDT；"
            f"持仓期间外部净入金{dtext(holding_in-holding_out)} USDT；"
            f"本交易正式净结果{summary['当前交易正式净结果']} USDT；"
            f"平仓后已确认资金事件滚动值{dtext(postclose)} USDT；"
            f"后一08:00实际总资产{summary['后一实际总资产']} USDT；"
            f"未分配快照差额{eligibility['未分配快照差额']} USDT。"
        )
    if negative:
        display += "按已确认资金事件计算的滚动结果为负，不能解释为真实账户总资产。"
    fund_rows.append({
        "T/U编号": tid,
        "前一张08:00实际总资产时间": summary["前一实际快照时间"],
        "前一张08:00实际总资产": summary["前一实际总资产"],
        "开仓前已确认资金事件滚动值": dtext(preopen) if tid != "T041" else "见T041反手三节点",
        "持仓期间外部入金": dtext(holding_in),
        "持仓期间外部出金": dtext(holding_out),
        "持仓期间外部净入金": dtext(holding_in - holding_out),
        "当前交易正式净结果": summary["当前交易正式净结果"],
        "其他个人主动交易影响": summary["其他个人主动交易影响"],
        "自动跟单影响": summary["自动跟单影响"],
        "返佣及其他账户事件": summary["返佣及其他账户事件"],
        "最大持仓时已确认资金事件滚动值": dtext(max_rolling),
        "平仓后已确认资金事件滚动值": dtext(postclose),
        "后一张08:00实际总资产时间": summary["后一实际快照时间"],

    if row.get("canonical_cash_inclusion") == "YES"

# T067首仓前10笔费用：以统一资金事件为主表，用原始流水行和阶段05 Fill交叉核对。
t067_cycle = cycle_by_tid["T067"]
t067_summary = summary_by_tid["T067"]
t067_attempt_time = parse_dt(t067_summary["第一次开仓委托尝试时间"])
t067_open_time = parse_dt(t067_summary["正式首仓时间"])
t067_open_group = next(group for group in group_by_tid["T067"] if group["role"] == "open")
t067_open_order = t067_open_group["order_id"]
t067_open_fills = [row for row in fills if norm_id(row.get("order_id")) == t067_open_order]
t067_open_fills.sort(key=lambda row: (parse_dt(row.get("fill_time_beijing")), dec(row.get("deterministic_sort_rank"))))
t067_fee_events = [
    row for row in unified
    if row.get("canonical_cash_inclusion") == "YES"
    and row.get("canonical_event_category") == "TRADING_COMMISSION"
    and t067_cycle in cycle_ids(row.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
    and t067_attempt_time <= parse_dt(row.get("event_time_beijing")) < t067_open_time
]
t067_fee_events.sort(key=lambda row: (parse_dt(row.get("event_time_beijing")), int(row.get("source_row_number") or 0)))
t067_fee_total = sumd(row.get("total_wealth_effect_exact") for row in t067_fee_events)

for index, event in enumerate(t067_fee_events, 1):
    when = parse_dt(event.get("event_time_beijing"))
    amount = dec(event.get("total_wealth_effect_exact"))
    ledger = raw_ledger[int(event.get("source_row_number"))]
    fill_matches = [
        row for row in t067_open_fills
        if parse_dt(row.get("fill_time_beijing")) == when
        and dec(row.get("commission")) == abs(amount)
    ]
    before = t067_running

    if row.get("canonical_cash_inclusion") == "YES"

    and t067_cycle in cycle_ids(row.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
    and t067_attempt_time <= parse_dt(row.get("event_time_beijing")) < t067_open_time

# 基础限价委托中的减仓或平仓意图，不以BUY/SELL单字段直接判断。
condition_generated_orders = {
    norm_id(row.get("生成基础订单号"))
    for row in stage_c_rows
    if row.get("T/U编号") in SELECTED and norm_id(row.get("生成基础订单号"))
}


def is_limit_reduce_candidate(row: dict) -> bool:
    if row.get("T/U编号") not in SELECTED:
        return False
    if row.get("事件大类") not in {"未成交基础委托", "正式成交委托"}:
        return False
    if not str(row.get("阶段区间") or "").startswith("B"):
        return False
    if str(row.get("委托类型") or "").upper() not in {"LIMIT", "限价"}:
        return False
    direction = row.get("多空仓位方向")
    side = str(row.get("买卖方向") or "").upper()
    direction_side_match = (
        (direction == "多头" and side in {"SELL", "卖出"})
        or (direction == "空头" and side in {"BUY", "买入"})
    )
    if not direction_side_match:
        return False
    before = dec(row.get("仓位变化前"))
    after = dec(row.get("仓位变化后"))
    filled = dec(row.get("实际成交数量"))
    position_evidence = (
        filled == 0 and before == after and before > 0
    ) or (
        filled > 0 and before > after >= 0
    )
    return position_evidence


limit_source_rows = [row for row in stage_b_rows if is_limit_reduce_candidate(row)]
limit_source_rows.sort(key=lambda row: (SELECTED.index(row["T/U编号"]), parse_dt(row["委托创建时间"]), norm_id(row["技术委托编号"])))
limit_rows: list[dict] = []
for row in limit_source_rows:
    before = dec(row["仓位变化前"])
    after = dec(row["仓位变化后"])
    filled = dec(row["实际成交数量"])
    order_id = norm_id(row["技术委托编号"])
    status = translate_enum(row["委托状态"])
    unfilled_cancel = filled == 0 and status == "已取消"
    unfilled_expire = filled == 0 and status in {"已过期", "撮合中过期"}
    partial_cancel = row["是否部分成交后撤余"] == "是"
    partial_reduce = filled > 0 and before > after > 0
    final_zero = filled > 0 and before > 0 and after == 0
    condition_generated = order_id in condition_generated_orders
    intent = "限价减多或平多尝试" if row["多空仓位方向"] == "多头" else "限价减空或平空尝试"
    if final_zero:
        fact = f"限价委托实际成交{dtext(filled)}，仓位由{dtext(before)}降至0，构成最终限价平仓。"
    elif partial_reduce:
        fact = f"限价委托实际成交{dtext(filled)}，仓位由{dtext(before)}降至{dtext(after)}，构成实际限价部分减仓。"
    elif unfilled_cancel:
        fact = f"限价委托已挂出但成交数量为0，随后取消；仓位保持{dtext(before)}。"
    elif unfilled_expire:
        fact = f"限价委托已挂出但成交数量为0，随后过期；仓位保持{dtext(before)}。"
    else:
        fact = translate_enum_tokens(row.get("中文解释"))
    limit_rows.append({
        "T/U编号": row["T/U编号"],
        "委托时间": row["委托创建时间"],
        "中文意图": intent,
        "委托价格": row["委托价格"],
        "委托数量": row["委托数量"],
        "实际成交数量": row["实际成交数量"],
        "最终状态": status,
        "reduceOnly证据": row.get("reduceOnly") or "不可得",
        "closePosition证据": row.get("closePosition") or "不可得",
        "仓位变化前": row["仓位变化前"],
        "仓位变化后": row["仓位变化后"],
        "是否未成交取消": "是" if unfilled_cancel else "否",
        "是否未成交过期": "是" if unfilled_expire else "否",
        "是否部分成交后撤余": "是" if partial_cancel else "否",
        "是否实际部分减仓": "是" if partial_reduce else "否",
        "是否最终使仓位归零": "是" if final_zero else "否",
        "是否普通限价委托": "否" if condition_generated else "是",
        "是否由条件委托触发生成": "是" if condition_generated else "否",
        "意图判定依据": "持仓方向＋买卖方向＋限价类型＋委托前后仓位＋实际成交量＋最终状态；reduceOnly和closePosition按正式源字段列示，缺失时不作虚构。",
        "中文事实说明": fact,
        "归属等级": row["归属置信度"],
        "是否需要人工确认": row["是否需要用户人工确认"],
        "技术委托编号": order_id,
        "技术来源": row["技术来源"],
    })

# 基础限价委托中的减仓或平仓意图，不以BUY/SELL单字段直接判断。
condition_generated_orders = {
    norm_id(row.get("生成基础订单号"))
    for row in stage_c_rows
    if row.get("T/U编号") in SELECTED and norm_id(row.get("生成基础订单号"))
}


def is_limit_reduce_candidate(row: dict) -> bool:
    if row.get("T/U编号") not in SELECTED:
        return False
    if row.get("事件大类") not in {"未成交基础委托", "正式成交委托"}:
        return False
    if not str(row.get("阶段区间") or "").startswith("B"):
        return False
    if str(row.get("委托类型") or "").upper() not in {"LIMIT", "限价"}:
        return False
    direction = row.get("多空仓位方向")
    side = str(row.get("买卖方向") or "").upper()
    direction_side_match = (
        (direction == "多头" and side in {"SELL", "卖出"})
        or (direction == "空头" and side in {"BUY", "买入"})
    )
    if not direction_side_match:
        return False
    before = dec(row.get("仓位变化前"))
    after = dec(row.get("仓位变化后"))
    filled = dec(row.get("实际成交数量"))
    position_evidence = (
        filled == 0 and before == after and before > 0
    ) or (
        filled > 0 and before > after >= 0
    )
    return position_evidence


limit_source_rows = [row for row in stage_b_rows if is_limit_reduce_candidate(row)]
limit_source_rows.sort(key=lambda row: (SELECTED.index(row["T/U编号"]), parse_dt(row["委托创建时间"]), norm_id(row["技术委托编号"])))
limit_rows: list[dict] = []
for row in limit_source_rows:
    before = dec(row["仓位变化前"])
    after = dec(row["仓位变化后"])
    filled = dec(row["实际成交数量"])
    order_id = norm_id(row["技术委托编号"])
    status = translate_enum(row["委托状态"])
    unfilled_cancel = filled == 0 and status == "已取消"
    unfilled_expire = filled == 0 and status in {"已过期", "撮合中过期"}
    partial_cancel = row["是否部分成交后撤余"] == "是"
    partial_reduce = filled > 0 and before > after > 0
    final_zero = filled > 0 and before > 0 and after == 0
    condition_generated = order_id in condition_generated_orders
    intent = "限价减多或平多尝试" if row["多空仓位方向"] == "多头" else "限价减空或平空尝试"
    if final_zero:
        fact = f"限价委托实际成交{dtext(filled)}，仓位由{dtext(before)}降至0，构成最终限价平仓。"
    elif partial_reduce:
        fact = f"限价委托实际成交{dtext(filled)}，仓位由{dtext(before)}降至{dtext(after)}，构成实际限价部分减仓。"
    elif unfilled_cancel:
        fact = f"限价委托已挂出但成交数量为0，随后取消；仓位保持{dtext(before)}。"
    elif unfilled_expire:
        fact = f"限价委托已挂出但成交数量为0，随后过期；仓位保持{dtext(before)}。"
    else:
        fact = translate_enum_tokens(row.get("中文解释"))
    limit_rows.append({
        "T/U编号": row["T/U编号"],
        "委托时间": row["委托创建时间"],
        "中文意图": intent,
        "委托价格": row["委托价格"],
        "委托数量": row["委托数量"],
        "实际成交数量": row["实际成交数量"],
        "最终状态": status,
        "reduceOnly证据": row.get("reduceOnly") or "不可得",
        "closePosition证据": row.get("closePosition") or "不可得",
        "仓位变化前": row["仓位变化前"],
        "仓位变化后": row["仓位变化后"],
        "是否未成交取消": "是" if unfilled_cancel else "否",
        "是否未成交过期": "是" if unfilled_expire else "否",
        "是否部分成交后撤余": "是" if partial_cancel else "否",
        "是否实际部分减仓": "是" if partial_reduce else "否",
        "是否最终使仓位归零": "是" if final_zero else "否",
        "是否普通限价委托": "否" if condition_generated else "是",
        "是否由条件委托触发生成": "是" if condition_generated else "否",
        "意图判定依据": "持仓方向＋买卖方向＋限价类型＋委托前后仓位＋实际成交量＋最终状态；reduceOnly和closePosition按正式源字段列示，缺失时不作虚构。",
        "中文事实说明": fact,
        "归属等级": row["归属置信度"],
        "是否需要人工确认": row["是否需要用户人工确认"],
        "技术委托编号": order_id,
        "技术来源": row["技术来源"],
    })
