def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)

        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))

    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

def order_group_summary(rows: list[dict], order_row: dict | None) -> dict:
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (dec(r.get("sequence_number")), dec(r.get("segment_sequence"))))
    before = abs(dec(rows[0].get("position_before")))
    after = abs(dec(rows[-1].get("position_after")))
    if before == 0 and after > 0:
        role = "open"
    elif after > before:
        role = "add"
    elif after == 0 and before > 0:
        role = "close"
    elif 0 < after < before:
        role = "reduce"
    else:
        role = "other"
    event_time = max(parse_dt(r.get("event_time_beijing")) for r in rows)
    qty = abs(after - before)
    if order_row and order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price") not in (None, ""):
        price = dec(order_row.get("weighted_average_fill_price"))
    else:
        segment_qty = [abs(dec(r.get("segment_quantity"))) for r in rows]
        denominator = sum(segment_qty, Decimal("0"))
        price = sum((q * dec(r.get("fill_price")) for q, r in zip(segment_qty, rows)), Decimal("0")) / denominator if denominator else Decimal("0")
    return {
        "order_id": norm_id(rows[0].get("order_id")),
        "time": event_time,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
        "quantity": qty,
        "price": price,
        "role": role,
        "rows": rows,
        "order_row": order_row or {},
        "after_avg": Decimal("0"),
    }

    known_total = dec(agg["total"])
    opening = dec(bridge["opening_snapshot_usdt_confirmed_exact"])
    actual_closing = dec(bridge["screenshot_closing_usdt_confirmed_exact"])
    rolling_closing = opening + known_total
    residual = actual_closing - rolling_closing
    stage_residual = dec(bridge["reconciliation_difference_exact"])

            "触发条件完整文本": row.get("trigger_full", ""),
            "触发价格基准": row.get("trigger_basis", ""),
            "比较符号": row.get("comparator", ""),
            "触发价格": row.get("trigger_price", ""),
            "状态": row.get("status", ""),
            "截图来源": (
                SCREENSHOT_DIRS["LIST"].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                + "/"
                + source_file
            ),
            "截图内行位置": int(row.get("row_position") or 0),
            "OCR最低置信度": float(row.get("ocr_confidence") or 0) / 100,

        }
        result["临时组合键"] = "|".join(
            normalize_key_piece(result[key])
            for key in [
                "合约",
                "条件委托列表时间",
                "页面中文类型",
                "方向",
                "数量",
                "触发条件完整文本",
                "状态",
            ]
        )
        if record_no is not None:
            result["条件记录临时ID"] = f"P0-COND-{record_no:04d}"
            sources = row.get("sources", [])

                f"{SCREENSHOT_DIRS['LIST'].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}/{item['file']}#行{item['row_position']}"
                for item in sources
            )
            result["重复出现次数"] = len(sources)
            result["去重结论"] = (
                "相邻截图重叠，合并为1条" if len(sources) > 1 else "单次出现"
            )
        return result

    visible = []

            converted["截图序号"] = screenshot_no
            visible.append(converted)
    deduped = [
        convert(row, int(row.get("record_no") or index))
        for index, row in enumerate(list_payload["dedup"], start=1)
    ]

def reviewed_list_records(reviewed: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict], list[dict]]:
    list_payload = reviewed["list"]

    def convert(row: dict, record_no: int | None = None) -> dict:
        source_file = row.get("source_file") or row.get("source_files", "").split("|")[0]
        quantity = f"{row.get('quantity', '')} {row.get('quantity_unit', '')}".strip()
        result = {
            "条件委托列表时间": row.get("time", ""),
            "合约": row.get("contract", ""),
            "永续标记": row.get("perpetual", "永续"),
            "页面中文类型": row.get("type", ""),
            "方向": row.get("direction", ""),
            "页面价格字段": row.get("page_price", ""),
            "数量": quantity,
            "只减仓": row.get("reduce_only", ""),
            "只做Maker": row.get("maker_only", ""),
            "触发条件完整文本": row.get("trigger_full", ""),
            "触发价格基准": row.get("trigger_basis", ""),
            "比较符号": row.get("comparator", ""),
            "触发价格": row.get("trigger_price", ""),
            "状态": row.get("status", ""),
            "截图来源": (
                SCREENSHOT_DIRS["LIST"].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                + "/"
                + source_file
            ),
            "截图内行位置": int(row.get("row_position") or 0),
            "OCR最低置信度": float(row.get("ocr_confidence") or 0) / 100,
            "字段可读性": "目标行清晰；关键字段已视觉复核",
            "人工复核状态": "已逐图视觉复核",
        }
        result["临时组合键"] = "|".join(
            normalize_key_piece(result[key])
            for key in [
                "合约",
                "条件委托列表时间",
                "页面中文类型",
                "方向",
                "数量",
                "触发条件完整文本",
                "状态",
            ]
        )
        if record_no is not None:
            result["条件记录临时ID"] = f"P0-COND-{record_no:04d}"
            sources = row.get("sources", [])
            result["全部截图来源"] = "｜".join(
                f"{SCREENSHOT_DIRS['LIST'].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}/{item['file']}#行{item['row_position']}"
                for item in sources
            )
            result["重复出现次数"] = len(sources)
            result["去重结论"] = (
                "相邻截图重叠，合并为1条" if len(sources) > 1 else "单次出现"
            )
        return result

    visible = []
    for screenshot_no, screen in enumerate(list_payload["screens"], start=1):
        for row in screen["rows"]:
            converted = convert(row)
            converted["截图序号"] = screenshot_no
            visible.append(converted)
    deduped = [
        convert(row, int(row.get("record_no") or index))
        for index, row in enumerate(list_payload["dedup"], start=1)
    ]

    }

    list_payload = reviewed["list"]

    def convert(row: dict, record_no: int | None = None) -> dict:
        source_file = row.get("source_file") or row.get("source_files", "").split("|")[0]
        quantity = f"{row.get('quantity', '')} {row.get('quantity_unit', '')}".strip()
        result = {
            "条件委托列表时间": row.get("time", ""),
            "合约": row.get("contract", ""),
            "永续标记": row.get("perpetual", "永续"),
            "页面中文类型": row.get("type", ""),
            "方向": row.get("direction", ""),
            "页面价格字段": row.get("page_price", ""),
            "数量": quantity,
            "只减仓": row.get("reduce_only", ""),
            "只做Maker": row.get("maker_only", ""),
            "触发条件完整文本": row.get("trigger_full", ""),
            "触发价格基准": row.get("trigger_basis", ""),
            "比较符号": row.get("comparator", ""),
            "触发价格": row.get("trigger_price", ""),
            "状态": row.get("status", ""),
            "截图来源": (
                SCREENSHOT_DIRS["LIST"].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                + "/"
                + source_file
            ),
            "截图内行位置": int(row.get("row_position") or 0),
            "OCR最低置信度": float(row.get("ocr_confidence") or 0) / 100,
            "字段可读性": "目标行清晰；关键字段已视觉复核",
            "人工复核状态": "已逐图视觉复核",
        }
        result["临时组合键"] = "|".join(
            normalize_key_piece(result[key])
            for key in [
                "合约",
                "条件委托列表时间",
                "页面中文类型",
                "方向",
                "数量",
                "触发条件完整文本",
                "状态",
            ]
        )
        if record_no is not None:
            result["条件记录临时ID"] = f"P0-COND-{record_no:04d}"
            sources = row.get("sources", [])
            result["全部截图来源"] = "｜".join(
                f"{SCREENSHOT_DIRS['LIST'].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}/{item['file']}#行{item['row_position']}"
                for item in sources

            visible.append(converted)

        convert(row, int(row.get("record_no") or index))
        for index, row in enumerate(list_payload["dedup"], start=1)
    ]

def reviewed_list_records(reviewed: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict], list[dict]]:
    list_payload = reviewed["list"]

    def convert(row: dict, record_no: int | None = None) -> dict:
        source_file = row.get("source_file") or row.get("source_files", "").split("|")[0]
        quantity = f"{row.get('quantity', '')} {row.get('quantity_unit', '')}".strip()
        result = {
            "条件委托列表时间": row.get("time", ""),
            "合约": row.get("contract", ""),
            "永续标记": row.get("perpetual", "永续"),
            "页面中文类型": row.get("type", ""),
            "方向": row.get("direction", ""),
            "页面价格字段": row.get("page_price", ""),
            "数量": quantity,
            "只减仓": row.get("reduce_only", ""),
            "只做Maker": row.get("maker_only", ""),
            "触发条件完整文本": row.get("trigger_full", ""),
            "触发价格基准": row.get("trigger_basis", ""),
            "比较符号": row.get("comparator", ""),
            "触发价格": row.get("trigger_price", ""),
            "状态": row.get("status", ""),
            "截图来源": (
                SCREENSHOT_DIRS["LIST"].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                + "/"
                + source_file
            ),
            "截图内行位置": int(row.get("row_position") or 0),
            "OCR最低置信度": float(row.get("ocr_confidence") or 0) / 100,
            "字段可读性": "目标行清晰；关键字段已视觉复核",
            "人工复核状态": "已逐图视觉复核",
        }
        result["临时组合键"] = "|".join(
            normalize_key_piece(result[key])
            for key in [
                "合约",
                "条件委托列表时间",
                "页面中文类型",
                "方向",
                "数量",
                "触发条件完整文本",
                "状态",
            ]
        )
        if record_no is not None:
            result["条件记录临时ID"] = f"P0-COND-{record_no:04d}"
            sources = row.get("sources", [])
            result["全部截图来源"] = "｜".join(
                f"{SCREENSHOT_DIRS['LIST'].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}/{item['file']}#行{item['row_position']}"
                for item in sources
            )
            result["重复出现次数"] = len(sources)
            result["去重结论"] = (
                "相邻截图重叠，合并为1条" if len(sources) > 1 else "单次出现"
            )
        return result

    visible = []
    for screenshot_no, screen in enumerate(list_payload["screens"], start=1):
        for row in screen["rows"]:
            converted = convert(row)
            converted["截图序号"] = screenshot_no
            visible.append(converted)
    deduped = [
        convert(row, int(row.get("record_no") or index))
        for index, row in enumerate(list_payload["dedup"], start=1)
    ]

def reviewed_list_records(reviewed: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict], list[dict]]:
    list_payload = reviewed["list"]

    def convert(row: dict, record_no: int | None = None) -> dict:
        source_file = row.get("source_file") or row.get("source_files", "").split("|")[0]
        quantity = f"{row.get('quantity', '')} {row.get('quantity_unit', '')}".strip()
        result = {
            "条件委托列表时间": row.get("time", ""),
            "合约": row.get("contract", ""),
            "永续标记": row.get("perpetual", "永续"),
            "页面中文类型": row.get("type", ""),
            "方向": row.get("direction", ""),
            "页面价格字段": row.get("page_price", ""),
            "数量": quantity,
            "只减仓": row.get("reduce_only", ""),
            "只做Maker": row.get("maker_only", ""),
            "触发条件完整文本": row.get("trigger_full", ""),
            "触发价格基准": row.get("trigger_basis", ""),
            "比较符号": row.get("comparator", ""),
            "触发价格": row.get("trigger_price", ""),
            "状态": row.get("status", ""),
            "截图来源": (
                SCREENSHOT_DIRS["LIST"].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
                + "/"
                + source_file
            ),
            "截图内行位置": int(row.get("row_position") or 0),
            "OCR最低置信度": float(row.get("ocr_confidence") or 0) / 100,
            "字段可读性": "目标行清晰；关键字段已视觉复核",
            "人工复核状态": "已逐图视觉复核",
        }
        result["临时组合键"] = "|".join(
            normalize_key_piece(result[key])
            for key in [
                "合约",
                "条件委托列表时间",
                "页面中文类型",
                "方向",
                "数量",
                "触发条件完整文本",
                "状态",
            ]
        )
        if record_no is not None:
            result["条件记录临时ID"] = f"P0-COND-{record_no:04d}"
            sources = row.get("sources", [])
            result["全部截图来源"] = "｜".join(
                f"{SCREENSHOT_DIRS['LIST'].relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}/{item['file']}#行{item['row_position']}"
                for item in sources
            )
            result["重复出现次数"] = len(sources)
            result["去重结论"] = (
                "相邻截图重叠，合并为1条" if len(sources) > 1 else "单次出现"
            )
        return result

    visible = []
    for screenshot_no, screen in enumerate(list_payload["screens"], start=1):
        for row in screen["rows"]:
            converted = convert(row)
            converted["截图序号"] = screenshot_no
            visible.append(converted)
    deduped = [
        convert(row, int(row.get("record_no") or index))
        for index, row in enumerate(list_payload["dedup"], start=1)
    ]

cycles_by_symbol: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for cycle in cycles:
        cycles_by_symbol[text(cycle.get("symbol"))].append(cycle)
    for grouped in cycles_by_symbol.values():
        grouped.sort(key=lambda item: parse_dt(item.get("start_time")) or datetime.min)
    formal_by_tid: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    direct_ids = {normalize_id(order.get("order_id")) for order in formal_orders}
    for order in formal_orders:
        formal_by_tid[text(order.get("tid"))].append(order)

    metrics: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for cycle in cycles:
        tid = text(cycle.get("tid"))
        start = parse_dt(cycle.get("start_time"))
        end = parse_dt(cycle.get("end_time"))
        symbol = text(cycle.get("symbol"))
        direction = text(cycle.get("direction"))
        pre = connected_pre_open_attempts(
            cycle, base_orders, cycles_by_symbol, direct_ids
        )
        holding_unfilled = [
            order
            for order in base_orders
            if order.get("合约") == symbol
            and normalize_id(order.get("主标识")) not in direct_ids
            and decimal_value(order.get("实际成交数量")) == 0
            and (parse_dt(order.get("北京时间")) or datetime.max)
            >= (start or datetime.max)
            and (parse_dt(order.get("北京时间")) or datetime.min)
            <= (end or datetime.min)
        ]
        add_attempts = sum(
            1
            for order in holding_unfilled
            if text(order.get("买卖方向")).upper() == opening_side(direction)
        )
        actual_adds = sum(
            1 for order in formal_by_tid[tid] if text(order.get("role")) == "ADD"
        )
        cycle_conditions = condition_candidates_for_cycle(cycle, conditions, cycles)
        cancel_expire = sum(
            1
            for condition, confidence in cycle_conditions
            if confidence in {"A", "B"}
            and text(condition.get("status")) in {"已取消", "已过期"}
        )
        order_total = len(formal_by_tid[tid])
        net_result = decimal_value(cycle.get("funds", {}).get("net_result"))
        final_exit_name = text(cycle.get("final_exit", {}).get("name"))
        personal = text(cycle.get("trading_type")) == "个人主动交易"
        self_report = cycle.get("manual_self_report") or {}
        has_plan = text(self_report.get("plan")).lower() in {
            "true",
            "是",
            "yes",
            "1",
        }
        metrics[tid] = {
            "pre_open_unfilled_attempt_count": len(pre),
            "holding_unfilled_add_attempt_count": add_attempts,
            "actual_add_order_count": actual_adds,
            "condition_cancel_or_expire_count": cancel_expire,
            "condition_event_count": len(cycle_conditions),
            "formal_order_count": order_total,
            "net_result": plain_decimal(net_result),
            "final_exit_name": final_exit_name,
            "trading_type": text(cycle.get("trading_type")),
            "manual_plan_true": has_plan,
        }

    excluded = set(FIXED_STAGE_B_TIDS)
    eligible = [cycle for cycle in cycles if text(cycle.get("tid")) not in excluded]

    def score_8(cycle: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str]:
        metric = metrics[text(cycle.get("tid"))]
        valid = (
            metric["pre_open_unfilled_attempt_count"] >= 2
            or (
                metric["holding_unfilled_add_attempt_count"] >= 2
                and metric["actual_add_order_count"] >= 1
            )
        )
        score = (
            metric["pre_open_unfilled_attempt_count"] * 5
            + metric["holding_unfilled_add_attempt_count"] * 4
            + metric["actual_add_order_count"] * 2
        )
        return (
            1 if valid else 0,
            score,
            metric["pre_open_unfilled_attempt_count"],
            text(cycle.get("tid")),
        )

    trade8 = max(eligible, key=score_8)
    tid8 = text(trade8.get("tid"))
    excluded.add(tid8)

    def score_9(cycle: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str]:
        metric = metrics[text(cycle.get("tid"))]
        real_other_exit = "条件" not in metric["final_exit_name"]
        return (
            1 if real_other_exit else 0,
            metric["condition_cancel_or_expire_count"],
            metric["condition_event_count"],
            text(cycle.get("tid")),
        )

    trade9 = max(
        [cycle for cycle in cycles if text(cycle.get("tid")) not in excluded],
        key=score_9,
    )
    tid9 = text(trade9.get("tid"))
    excluded.add(tid9)

    def score_10(cycle: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, int, int, Decimal, str]:
        metric = metrics[text(cycle.get("tid"))]
        simple = (
            metric["trading_type"] == "个人主动交易"
            and decimal_value(metric["net_result"]) > 0
            and metric["formal_order_count"] == 2
            and metric["actual_add_order_count"] == 0
            and metric["condition_event_count"] <= 2
        )
        return (
            1 if simple else 0,
            1 if metric["manual_plan_true"] else 0,
            -metric["condition_event_count"],
            decimal_value(metric["net_result"]),
            text(cycle.get("tid")),
        )

    trade10 = max(
        [cycle for cycle in cycles if text(cycle.get("tid")) not in excluded],
        key=score_10,
    )
    tid10 = text(trade10.get("tid"))
    reasons = {
        tid8: (
            "规则8：客观指标最高；"
            f"首仓前未成交尝试{metrics[tid8]['pre_open_unfilled_attempt_count']}张，"
            f"持仓中加仓尝试{metrics[tid8]['holding_unfilled_add_attempt_count']}张，"
            f"实际加仓{metrics[tid8]['actual_add_order_count']}张。"
        ),
        tid9: (
            "规则9：条件委托取消/过期事件代表性最高；"
            f"A/B级取消或过期{metrics[tid9]['condition_cancel_or_expire_count']}张，"
            f"最终平仓={metrics[tid9]['final_exit_name']}，由真实归零订单确认。"
        ),
        tid10: (
            "规则10：个人主动交易、净结果为正、正式订单仅开平两张、"
            f"无实际加仓；净结果={metrics[tid10]['net_result']}。"
        ),
    }
    return FIXED_STAGE_B_TIDS + [tid8, tid9, tid10], reasons, metrics

        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(events)
    temp.replace(STAGE_B_CSV)

def run_stage_b(force: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stage_a_result = validate_stage_a_for_stage_b()
    if not force and stage_b_checkpoint_valid():
        result = json.loads(STAGE_B_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        log("阶段B断点哈希有效，跳过重复运行。")
        return result

    log("阶段B开始：只读取有效阶段A断点，构建10笔仓位完整操作链。")
    stage_a_rows = load_stage_a_rows()
    payload = load_p3_payload()
    cycles: list[dict[str, Any]] = payload["cycles"]
    formal_orders: list[dict[str, Any]] = payload["orders"]
    conditions: list[dict[str, Any]] = payload["conditions"]
    base_orders = [
        row for row in stage_a_rows if row.get("事件大类") == "基础委托"
    ]
    base_by_id = {
        normalize_id(row.get("主标识")): row for row in base_orders
    }
    direct_ids = {normalize_id(order.get("order_id")) for order in formal_orders}
    cycle_map = {text(cycle.get("tid")): cycle for cycle in cycles}
    cycles_by_symbol: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for cycle in cycles:
        cycles_by_symbol[text(cycle.get("symbol"))].append(cycle)
    for grouped in cycles_by_symbol.values():
        grouped.sort(key=lambda item: parse_dt(item.get("start_time")) or datetime.min)
    formal_by_tid: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for order in formal_orders:
        formal_by_tid[text(order.get("tid"))].append(order)

    selected_tids, auto_reasons, selection_metrics = auto_select_stage_b_trades(
        cycles, base_orders, formal_orders, conditions
    )
    events: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    residual_event_count = 0

    for tid in selected_tids:
        cycle = cycle_map[tid]
        tid_orders = sorted(
            formal_by_tid[tid],
            key=lambda order: parse_dt(order.get("order_time")) or datetime.max,
        )
        start = parse_dt(cycle.get("start_time"))
        end = parse_dt(cycle.get("end_time"))
        symbol = text(cycle.get("symbol"))
        direction = text(cycle.get("direction"))
        before_count = len(events)

        pre_attempts = connected_pre_open_attempts(
            cycle, base_orders, cycles_by_symbol, direct_ids
        )
        for order in pre_attempts:
            events.append(
                unfilled_order_event(
                    order,
                    cycle,
                    tid_orders,
                    "A｜首仓前开仓意图链",
                    "B",
                )
            )
        for order in tid_orders:
            events.append(direct_order_event(order))

        holding_candidates: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        residual_candidates: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        for order in base_orders:
            created = parse_dt(order.get("北京时间"))
            ended = parse_dt(order.get("结束或更新时间")) or created
            order_id = normalize_id(order.get("主标识"))
            if (
                order.get("合约") != symbol
                or order_id in direct_ids
                or decimal_value(order.get("实际成交数量")) != 0
                or created is None
                or start is None
                or end is None
                or not (start <= created <= end)
            ):
                continue
            if ended is not None and ended > end:
                residual_candidates.append(order)
            else:
                holding_candidates.append(order)

        for order in holding_candidates:
            active = [
                other
                for other in cycles
                if text(other.get("symbol")) == symbol
                and (parse_dt(other.get("start_time")) or datetime.max)
                <= (parse_dt(order.get("北京时间")) or datetime.min)
                <= (parse_dt(other.get("end_time")) or datetime.min)
            ]
            confidence = "B" if len(active) == 1 else "C"
            events.append(
                unfilled_order_event(
                    order,
                    cycle,
                    tid_orders,
                    "B｜持仓期间操作链",
                    confidence,
                )
            )
        for order in residual_candidates:
            active = [
                other
                for other in cycles
                if text(other.get("symbol")) == symbol
                and (parse_dt(other.get("start_time")) or datetime.max)
                <= (parse_dt(order.get("北京时间")) or datetime.min)
                <= (parse_dt(other.get("end_time")) or datetime.min)
            ]
            confidence = "B" if len(active) == 1 else "C"
            events.append(
                residual_order_event(order, cycle, tid_orders, confidence)
            )
            residual_event_count += 1

        for condition, confidence in condition_candidates_for_cycle(
            cycle, conditions, cycles
        ):
            condition_row = condition_event(
                condition, cycle, tid_orders, confidence
            )
            events.append(condition_row)
            if condition_row["阶段区间"].startswith("C"):
                residual_event_count += 1

        tid_events = events[before_count:]

    for order in formal_orders:
        formal_by_tid[text(order.get("tid"))].append(order)

    metrics: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for cycle in cycles:
        tid = text(cycle.get("tid"))
        start = parse_dt(cycle.get("start_time"))
        end = parse_dt(cycle.get("end_time"))
        symbol = text(cycle.get("symbol"))
        direction = text(cycle.get("direction"))
        pre = connected_pre_open_attempts(
            cycle, base_orders, cycles_by_symbol, direct_ids
        )

            order
            for order in base_orders
            if order.get("合约") == symbol
            and normalize_id(order.get("主标识")) not in direct_ids
            and decimal_value(order.get("实际成交数量")) == 0
            and (parse_dt(order.get("北京时间")) or datetime.max)
            >= (start or datetime.max)
            and (parse_dt(order.get("北京时间")) or datetime.min)
            <= (end or datetime.min)
        ]
        add_attempts = sum(
            1
            for order in holding_unfilled
            if text(order.get("买卖方向")).upper() == opening_side(direction)
        )
        actual_adds = sum(
            1 for order in formal_by_tid[tid] if text(order.get("role")) == "ADD"
        )
        cycle_conditions = condition_candidates_for_cycle(cycle, conditions, cycles)
        cancel_expire = sum(
            1
            for condition, confidence in cycle_conditions
            if confidence in {"A", "B"}
            and text(condition.get("status")) in {"已取消", "已过期"}
        )
        order_total = len(formal_by_tid[tid])
        net_result = decimal_value(cycle.get("funds", {}).get("net_result"))
        final_exit_name = text(cycle.get("final_exit", {}).get("name"))
        personal = text(cycle.get("trading_type")) == "个人主动交易"
        self_report = cycle.get("manual_self_report") or {}
        has_plan = text(self_report.get("plan")).lower() in {
            "true",
            "是",
            "yes",
            "1",
        }
        metrics[tid] = {
            "pre_open_unfilled_attempt_count": len(pre),
            "holding_unfilled_add_attempt_count": add_attempts,
            "actual_add_order_count": actual_adds,
            "condition_cancel_or_expire_count": cancel_expire,
            "condition_event_count": len(cycle_conditions),
            "formal_order_count": order_total,
            "net_result": plain_decimal(net_result),

            "manual_plan_true": has_plan,

    excluded = set(FIXED_STAGE_B_TIDS)

    def score_8(cycle: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str]:
        metric = metrics[text(cycle.get("tid"))]
        valid = (

            or (
                metric["holding_unfilled_add_attempt_count"] >= 2
                and metric["actual_add_order_count"] >= 1
            )
        )
        score = (
            metric["pre_open_unfilled_attempt_count"] * 5
            + metric["holding_unfilled_add_attempt_count"] * 4
            + metric["actual_add_order_count"] * 2
        )
        return (
            1 if valid else 0,
            score,
            metric["pre_open_unfilled_attempt_count"],
            text(cycle.get("tid")),
        )

    trade8 = max(eligible, key=score_8)

    excluded.add(tid8)

        real_other_exit = "条件" not in metric["final_exit_name"]
        return (
            1 if real_other_exit else 0,
            metric["condition_cancel_or_expire_count"],
            metric["condition_event_count"],
            text(cycle.get("tid")),
        )

    trade9 = max(

    )

    excluded.add(tid9)

    def score_10(cycle: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, int, int, Decimal, str]:
        metric = metrics[text(cycle.get("tid"))]
        simple = (
            metric["trading_type"] == "个人主动交易"
            and decimal_value(metric["net_result"]) > 0
            and metric["formal_order_count"] == 2
            and metric["actual_add_order_count"] == 0
            and metric["condition_event_count"] <= 2
        )
        return (
            1 if simple else 0,
            1 if metric["manual_plan_true"] else 0,
            -metric["condition_event_count"],
            decimal_value(metric["net_result"]),
            text(cycle.get("tid")),
        )

    trade10 = max(
        [cycle for cycle in cycles if text(cycle.get("tid")) not in excluded],
        key=score_10,
    )
    tid10 = text(trade10.get("tid"))
    reasons = {
        tid8: (
            "规则8：客观指标最高；"
            f"首仓前未成交尝试{metrics[tid8]['pre_open_unfilled_attempt_count']}张，"
            f"持仓中加仓尝试{metrics[tid8]['holding_unfilled_add_attempt_count']}张，"
            f"实际加仓{metrics[tid8]['actual_add_order_count']}张。"

        tid9: (
            "规则9：条件委托取消/过期事件代表性最高；"
            f"A/B级取消或过期{metrics[tid9]['condition_cancel_or_expire_count']}张，"
            f"最终平仓={metrics[tid9]['final_exit_name']}，由真实归零订单确认。"

    condition: dict[str, Any],
    cycle: dict[str, Any],
    formal_orders: list[dict[str, Any]],
    confidence: str,

def run_stage_b(force: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stage_a_result = validate_stage_a_for_stage_b()
    if not force and stage_b_checkpoint_valid():
        result = json.loads(STAGE_B_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        log("阶段B断点哈希有效，跳过重复运行。")
        return result

    log("阶段B开始：只读取有效阶段A断点，构建10笔仓位完整操作链。")
    stage_a_rows = load_stage_a_rows()
    payload = load_p3_payload()
    cycles: list[dict[str, Any]] = payload["cycles"]
    formal_orders: list[dict[str, Any]] = payload["orders"]
    conditions: list[dict[str, Any]] = payload["conditions"]
    base_orders = [
        row for row in stage_a_rows if row.get("事件大类") == "基础委托"
    ]
    base_by_id = {
        normalize_id(row.get("主标识")): row for row in base_orders
    }
    direct_ids = {normalize_id(order.get("order_id")) for order in formal_orders}
    cycle_map = {text(cycle.get("tid")): cycle for cycle in cycles}
    cycles_by_symbol: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for cycle in cycles:
        cycles_by_symbol[text(cycle.get("symbol"))].append(cycle)
    for grouped in cycles_by_symbol.values():
        grouped.sort(key=lambda item: parse_dt(item.get("start_time")) or datetime.min)
    formal_by_tid: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for order in formal_orders:
        formal_by_tid[text(order.get("tid"))].append(order)

    selected_tids, auto_reasons, selection_metrics = auto_select_stage_b_trades(
        cycles, base_orders, formal_orders, conditions
    )
    events: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    residual_event_count = 0

    for tid in selected_tids:
        cycle = cycle_map[tid]
        tid_orders = sorted(
            formal_by_tid[tid],
            key=lambda order: parse_dt(order.get("order_time")) or datetime.max,
        )
        start = parse_dt(cycle.get("start_time"))
        end = parse_dt(cycle.get("end_time"))
        symbol = text(cycle.get("symbol"))
        direction = text(cycle.get("direction"))
        before_count = len(events)

        pre_attempts = connected_pre_open_attempts(
            cycle, base_orders, cycles_by_symbol, direct_ids
        )
        for order in pre_attempts:
            events.append(
                unfilled_order_event(
                    order,
                    cycle,
                    tid_orders,
                    "A｜首仓前开仓意图链",
                    "B",
                )
            )
        for order in tid_orders:
            events.append(direct_order_event(order))

        holding_candidates: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        residual_candidates: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        for order in base_orders:
            created = parse_dt(order.get("北京时间"))
            ended = parse_dt(order.get("结束或更新时间")) or created
            order_id = normalize_id(order.get("主标识"))
            if (
                order.get("合约") != symbol
                or order_id in direct_ids
                or decimal_value(order.get("实际成交数量")) != 0
                or created is None
                or start is None
                or end is None
                or not (start <= created <= end)
            ):
                continue
            if ended is not None and ended > end:
                residual_candidates.append(order)
            else:
                holding_candidates.append(order)

        for order in holding_candidates:
            active = [
                other
                for other in cycles
                if text(other.get("symbol")) == symbol
                and (parse_dt(other.get("start_time")) or datetime.max)
                <= (parse_dt(order.get("北京时间")) or datetime.min)
                <= (parse_dt(other.get("end_time")) or datetime.min)
            ]
            confidence = "B" if len(active) == 1 else "C"
            events.append(
                unfilled_order_event(
                    order,
                    cycle,
                    tid_orders,
                    "B｜持仓期间操作链",
                    confidence,
                )
            )
        for order in residual_candidates:
            active = [
                other
                for other in cycles
                if text(other.get("symbol")) == symbol
                and (parse_dt(other.get("start_time")) or datetime.max)
                <= (parse_dt(order.get("北京时间")) or datetime.min)
                <= (parse_dt(other.get("end_time")) or datetime.min)
            ]
            confidence = "B" if len(active) == 1 else "C"
            events.append(
                residual_order_event(order, cycle, tid_orders, confidence)
            )
            residual_event_count += 1

        for condition, confidence in condition_candidates_for_cycle(
            cycle, conditions, cycles
        ):
            condition_row = condition_event(
                condition, cycle, tid_orders, confidence
            )
            events.append(condition_row)
            if condition_row["阶段区间"].startswith("C"):
                residual_event_count += 1

        tid_events = events[before_count:]

def read_raw_orders() -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], list[str]]:
    events: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    errors: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    cache_valid = False
    if RAW_ORDER_CACHE.is_file():
        try:
            cached = json.loads(RAW_ORDER_CACHE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            cache_valid = (
                cached.get("source") == str(RAW_ORDERS)
                and len(cached.get("records", [])) == EXPECTED_COUNTS["基础委托"]
            )
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
            cache_valid = False
    if not cache_valid:
        subprocess.run(
            [str(NODE), str(RAW_ORDER_EXTRACTOR)],
            cwd=str(TECH),
            check=True,
        )
        cached = json.loads(RAW_ORDER_CACHE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    for record in cached["records"]:
        row_number = int(record.pop("__source_row__", 0))
        order_id = normalize_id(record.get("订单编号"))
        if not order_id:
            errors.append(f"基础委托第{row_number}行缺少订单编号")
            continue
        if order_id in seen:
            errors.append(f"基础委托订单编号重复：{order_id}")
            continue
        seen.add(order_id)
        event = empty_event()
        event.update(
            {
                "事件大类": "基础委托",
                "事件子类": "全部基础委托",
                "来源文件": RAW_ORDERS.name,
                "来源工作表": "Sheet0",
                "来源行号": str(row_number),
                "来源记录ID": order_id,
                "主标识": order_id,
                "北京时间": normalize_time(record.get("时间")),
                "结束或更新时间": normalize_time(record.get("更新时间")),
                "合约": text(record.get("代币名称/币种名称/币对")),
                "买卖方向": text(record.get("方向")),
                "委托类型": text(record.get("类型")),
                "最终状态": text(record.get("状态")),
                "委托价格": plain_decimal(record.get("价格")),
                "触发价格": plain_decimal(record.get("止损价格")),
                "原始数量": plain_decimal(record.get("金额")),
                "实际成交数量": plain_decimal(record.get("执行金额")),
                "成交报价金额": plain_decimal(record.get("已执行报价金额")),
                "归属状态": "阶段A未执行T/U归属；阶段B处理",
                "关联订单号": order_id,
                "原始状态": text(record.get("状态")),
                "中文说明": "交易所导出的全部基础委托；包含成交、未成交取消、过期及部分成交后撤余。",
            }
        )
        events.append(event)
    return events, errors

def read_raw_orders() -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], list[str]]:
    events: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    errors: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    cache_valid = False
    if RAW_ORDER_CACHE.is_file():
        try:
            cached = json.loads(RAW_ORDER_CACHE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            cache_valid = (
                cached.get("source") == str(RAW_ORDERS)
                and len(cached.get("records", [])) == EXPECTED_COUNTS["基础委托"]
            )
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
            cache_valid = False
    if not cache_valid:
        subprocess.run(
            [str(NODE), str(RAW_ORDER_EXTRACTOR)],
            cwd=str(TECH),
            check=True,
        )
        cached = json.loads(RAW_ORDER_CACHE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    for record in cached["records"]:
        row_number = int(record.pop("__source_row__", 0))
        order_id = normalize_id(record.get("订单编号"))
        if not order_id:
            errors.append(f"基础委托第{row_number}行缺少订单编号")
            continue
        if order_id in seen:
            errors.append(f"基础委托订单编号重复：{order_id}")
            continue
        seen.add(order_id)
        event = empty_event()
        event.update(
            {
                "事件大类": "基础委托",
                "事件子类": "全部基础委托",
                "来源文件": RAW_ORDERS.name,
                "来源工作表": "Sheet0",
                "来源行号": str(row_number),
                "来源记录ID": order_id,
                "主标识": order_id,
                "北京时间": normalize_time(record.get("时间")),
                "结束或更新时间": normalize_time(record.get("更新时间")),
                "合约": text(record.get("代币名称/币种名称/币对")),
                "买卖方向": text(record.get("方向")),
                "委托类型": text(record.get("类型")),
                "最终状态": text(record.get("状态")),
                "委托价格": plain_decimal(record.get("价格")),
                "触发价格": plain_decimal(record.get("止损价格")),
                "原始数量": plain_decimal(record.get("金额")),
                "实际成交数量": plain_decimal(record.get("执行金额")),
                "成交报价金额": plain_decimal(record.get("已执行报价金额")),
                "归属状态": "阶段A未执行T/U归属；阶段B处理",
                "关联订单号": order_id,
                "原始状态": text(record.get("状态")),
                "中文说明": "交易所导出的全部基础委托；包含成交、未成交取消、过期及部分成交后撤余。",
            }
        )
        events.append(event)
    return events, errors

    temp.replace(path)

payload = load_p3_payload()
    cycle_to_tid, _ = build_p3_maps(payload)

    all_events: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    all_errors: list[str] = []
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}

    readers = [
        ("基础委托", lambda: read_raw_orders()),
        ("正式Order", lambda: read_formal_orders(payload)),
        ("Fill", lambda: read_fills(payload)),
        ("条件委托", lambda: read_conditions(payload)),
        ("T/U周期", lambda: read_cycles(payload)),
        ("资金事件", lambda: read_fund_events(cycle_to_tid)),
        ("账户快照", lambda: read_snapshots()),
    ]
    for label, reader in readers:
        records, errors = reader()
        counts[label] = len(records)
        all_events.extend(records)
        all_errors.extend(errors)
        log(f"阶段A读取完成：{label} {len(records):,}条；错误{len(errors)}条。")

    for label, expected in EXPECTED_COUNTS.items():
        actual = counts.get(label, 0)
        if actual != expected:
            all_errors.append(f"{label}数量不一致：实际{actual}，期望{expected}")

    sort_rank = {
        "账户快照": 1,
        "T/U周期": 2,
        "基础委托": 3,
        "正式Order": 4,
        "Fill": 5,
        "条件委托": 6,
        "资金事件": 7,
    }
    all_events.sort(
        key=lambda row: (
            row["北京时间"] or "9999-12-31 23:59:59",
            sort_rank.get(row["事件大类"], 99),
            row["主标识"],
        )
    )
    for index, event in enumerate(all_events, start=1):
        event["统一事件行号"] = f"UE-{index:06d}"

def add_dataset(
        key: str,
        title: str,
        relative_output: str,
        rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
        notes: str,
        warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        columns = column_defs(rows)
        data_path = WORK_DIR / f"{key}.jsonl"
        write_jsonl(data_path, rows)
        manifest["datasets"].append(
            {
                "key": key,
                "title": title,
                "notes": notes,
                "output_path": str(STAGE_DIR / relative_output),
                "data_jsonl": str(data_path),
                "expected_record_count": len(rows),
                "data_columns": columns,
                "field_description_rows": field_rows(columns),
                "warnings": warnings or [{"状态": "无新增阻断异常"}],
                "reconciliation": [
                    {
                        "check_item": "记录数量",
                        "source_count": len(rows),
                        "output_count": len(rows),
                        "difference": 0,
                        "status": "PASS",
                    }
                ],
                "source_info": [
                    {
                        "stage": "阶段07",
                        "input_scope": "阶段04—06正式输入/B01/原始截图只读",
                        "output_scope": relative_output,
                        "build_script": str(SCRIPT.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        "xlsx_authoring_engine": "@oai/artifact-tool",
                        "phase08_executed": "否",
                    }
                ],
            }
        )

            "source_dataset": "B01_COPY_FUNDING",
            "source_file": raw.get("source_file"),

            "event_time_utc": normalized_time(raw.get("event_time_utc")),
            "event_time_beijing": raw.get("event_time_beijing"),
            "asset": raw.get("asset_standard"),
            "symbol": raw.get("symbol_standard"),
            "amount_raw": raw.get("amount_raw"),
            "amount_signed_exact": decimal_text(amount),
            "account_scope": "COPY_TRADING_PORTFOLIO",
            "source_account": (

                if amount > 0
                else "COPY_TRADING_PORTFOLIO"
            ),
            "destination_account": (
                "COPY_TRADING_PORTFOLIO"
                if amount > 0

            ),
            "account_balance_effect_exact": decimal_text(amount),

            "total_wealth_effect_status": "MIRROR_COPY_FUNDING_EVIDENCE",

# 资金费：48个单候选；6个双候选通过B01跟单侧直接证据拆分账户范围。
    funding_allocation_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    funding_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    funding_events_by_cycle: dict[str, list[str]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    funding_candidate_by_source = {
        str(row["funding_event_record_id"]): row for row in funding_candidates
    }
    for candidate in funding_candidates:
        source_id = str(candidate["funding_event_record_id"])
        candidates = pipe_ids(candidate.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
        b01_raw = future_source_to_b01.get(source_id)
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            assigned_cycle = candidates[0]
            attribution = "UNIQUE_OPEN_CYCLE_AT_SETTLEMENT"
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F3"
        elif len(candidates) == 2:
            matching = [
                cycle_id
                for cycle_id in candidates
                if cycle_origin.get(cycle_id)
                == ("COPY_TRADING" if b01_raw else "PERSONAL_ACTIVE")
            ]
            if len(matching) != 1:
                raise RuntimeError(f"资金费账户范围消歧失败：{source_id}")
            assigned_cycle = matching[0]
            attribution = (
                "B01_DIRECT_COPY_EVENT"
                if b01_raw
                else "B01_IDENTIFIED_COPY_COUNTERPART_LEAVES_NORMAL_ACCOUNT_EVENT"
            )
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F2+F3" if b01_raw else "F3"
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(f"资金费候选数异常：{source_id} {len(candidates)}")
        amount = decimal_value(candidate.get("amount")) or ZERO
        funding_by_cycle[assigned_cycle] += amount
        funding_events_by_cycle[assigned_cycle].append(source_id)
        funding_allocation_rows.append(
            {
                **candidate,
                "assigned_position_cycle_id": assigned_cycle,
                "assigned_T_or_U": (
                    cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("manual_review_trade_ids")
                    or cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("u_number")
                ),
                "trading_origin": cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("trading_origin"),
                "ordinary_or_copy_attribution": (
                    "COPY" if b01_raw else "NORMAL_FUTURES"
                ),
                "B01_standard_record_id": (
                    b01_raw.get("standard_record_id") if b01_raw else None
                ),
                "stage07_attribution_basis": attribution,
                "stage07_attribution_confidence": confidence,
                "stage07_evidence_level": evidence_level,
                "stage07_allocation_status": "ALLOCATED_WITH_ACCOUNT_SCOPE_EVIDENCE",
                "double_count_prevention": (
                    "B01与普通合约同一资金费只计普通合约canonical一次"
                    if b01_raw
                    else "普通合约canonical只计一次"
                ),
            }
        )
        future_row = unified_by_source[source_id]
        future_row["candidate_position_cycle_ids"] = "|".join(candidates)
        future_row["cycle_allocation_status"] = (
            "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CYCLE_FUNDING"
        )
        future_row["account_scope"] = (
            "COPY_TRADING_PORTFOLIO"
            if cycle_origin.get(assigned_cycle) == "COPY_TRADING"
            else "UM_FUTURES_ACCOUNT"
        )

        raise RuntimeError("54笔资金费未全部完成阶段07账户范围消歧")

    rebate_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    rebate_count_by_cycle: dict[str, int] = collections.defaultdict(int)
    for row in unified:
        if (
            row["source_dataset"] == "FUTURES_LEDGER"
            and row["source_business_type_standard"] == "COMMISSION_REBATE"
        ):
            candidates = pipe_ids(row.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
            if len(candidates) == 1:
                rebate_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += (
                    decimal_value(row["amount_signed_exact"]) or ZERO
                )
                rebate_count_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += 1
                row["cycle_allocation_status"] = "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CANDIDATE_NOT_DIRECT"

def add_dataset(
        key: str,
        title: str,
        relative_output: str,
        rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
        notes: str,
        warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    ) -> None:

            {
                "key": key,
                "title": title,
                "notes": notes,
                "output_path": str(STAGE_DIR / relative_output),
                "data_jsonl": str(data_path),
                "expected_record_count": len(rows),
                "data_columns": columns,
                "field_description_rows": field_rows(columns),

def add_dataset(
        key: str,
        title: str,
        relative_output: str,
        rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
        notes: str,
        warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        columns = column_defs(rows)
        data_path = WORK_DIR / f"{key}.jsonl"
        write_jsonl(data_path, rows)
        manifest["datasets"].append(
            {
                "key": key,
                "title": title,
                "notes": notes,
                "output_path": str(STAGE_DIR / relative_output),
                "data_jsonl": str(data_path),
                "expected_record_count": len(rows),
                "data_columns": columns,
                "field_description_rows": field_rows(columns),
                "warnings": warnings or [{"状态": "无新增阻断异常"}],
                "reconciliation": [
                    {
                        "check_item": "记录数量",
                        "source_count": len(rows),
                        "output_count": len(rows),
                        "difference": 0,
                        "status": "PASS",
                    }
                ],
                "source_info": [
                    {
                        "stage": "阶段07",
                        "input_scope": "阶段04—06正式输入/B01/原始截图只读",
                        "output_scope": relative_output,
                        "build_script": str(SCRIPT.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        "xlsx_authoring_engine": "@oai/artifact-tool",
                        "phase08_executed": "否",
                    }
                ],
            }
        )

                if b01_raw

            )
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F2+F3" if b01_raw else "F3"
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(f"资金费候选数异常：{source_id} {len(candidates)}")
        amount = decimal_value(candidate.get("amount")) or ZERO
        funding_by_cycle[assigned_cycle] += amount
        funding_events_by_cycle[assigned_cycle].append(source_id)
        funding_allocation_rows.append(
            {
                **candidate,
                "assigned_position_cycle_id": assigned_cycle,
                "assigned_T_or_U": (
                    cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("manual_review_trade_ids")
                    or cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("u_number")
                ),
                "trading_origin": cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("trading_origin"),
                "ordinary_or_copy_attribution": (
                    "COPY" if b01_raw else "NORMAL_FUTURES"
                ),
                "B01_standard_record_id": (
                    b01_raw.get("standard_record_id") if b01_raw else None
                ),
                "stage07_attribution_basis": attribution,
                "stage07_attribution_confidence": confidence,
                "stage07_evidence_level": evidence_level,
                "stage07_allocation_status": "ALLOCATED_WITH_ACCOUNT_SCOPE_EVIDENCE",
                "double_count_prevention": (
                    "B01与普通合约同一资金费只计普通合约canonical一次"
                    if b01_raw
                    else "普通合约canonical只计一次"
                ),
            }
        )
        future_row = unified_by_source[source_id]
        future_row["candidate_position_cycle_ids"] = "|".join(candidates)
        future_row["cycle_allocation_status"] = (
            "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CYCLE_FUNDING"
        )
        future_row["account_scope"] = (
            "COPY_TRADING_PORTFOLIO"
            if cycle_origin.get(assigned_cycle) == "COPY_TRADING"
            else "UM_FUTURES_ACCOUNT"
        )

    if len(funding_allocation_rows) != 54:
        raise RuntimeError("54笔资金费未全部完成阶段07账户范围消歧")

    # 手续费返还只形成周期候选，不因缺少直接业务ID而强制计入周期现金结果。
    rebate_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    rebate_count_by_cycle: dict[str, int] = collections.defaultdict(int)
    for row in unified:
        if (
            row["source_dataset"] == "FUTURES_LEDGER"
            and row["source_business_type_standard"] == "COMMISSION_REBATE"
        ):
            candidates = pipe_ids(row.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
            if len(candidates) == 1:
                rebate_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += (
                    decimal_value(row["amount_signed_exact"]) or ZERO
                )
                rebate_count_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += 1
                row["cycle_allocation_status"] = "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CANDIDATE_NOT_DIRECT"

    funding_allocation_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    funding_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    funding_events_by_cycle: dict[str, list[str]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    funding_candidate_by_source = {
        str(row["funding_event_record_id"]): row for row in funding_candidates
    }
    for candidate in funding_candidates:
        source_id = str(candidate["funding_event_record_id"])
        candidates = pipe_ids(candidate.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
        b01_raw = future_source_to_b01.get(source_id)
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            assigned_cycle = candidates[0]
            attribution = "UNIQUE_OPEN_CYCLE_AT_SETTLEMENT"
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F3"
        elif len(candidates) == 2:
            matching = [
                cycle_id
                for cycle_id in candidates
                if cycle_origin.get(cycle_id)
                == ("COPY_TRADING" if b01_raw else "PERSONAL_ACTIVE")
            ]
            if len(matching) != 1:
                raise RuntimeError(f"资金费账户范围消歧失败：{source_id}")
            assigned_cycle = matching[0]
            attribution = (
                "B01_DIRECT_COPY_EVENT"
                if b01_raw
                else "B01_IDENTIFIED_COPY_COUNTERPART_LEAVES_NORMAL_ACCOUNT_EVENT"
            )
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F2+F3" if b01_raw else "F3"
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(f"资金费候选数异常：{source_id} {len(candidates)}")
        amount = decimal_value(candidate.get("amount")) or ZERO
        funding_by_cycle[assigned_cycle] += amount
        funding_events_by_cycle[assigned_cycle].append(source_id)
        funding_allocation_rows.append(
            {
                **candidate,
                "assigned_position_cycle_id": assigned_cycle,
                "assigned_T_or_U": (
                    cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("manual_review_trade_ids")
                    or cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("u_number")
                ),
                "trading_origin": cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("trading_origin"),
                "ordinary_or_copy_attribution": (
                    "COPY" if b01_raw else "NORMAL_FUTURES"
                ),
                "B01_standard_record_id": (
                    b01_raw.get("standard_record_id") if b01_raw else None
                ),
                "stage07_attribution_basis": attribution,
                "stage07_attribution_confidence": confidence,
                "stage07_evidence_level": evidence_level,
                "stage07_allocation_status": "ALLOCATED_WITH_ACCOUNT_SCOPE_EVIDENCE",
                "double_count_prevention": (
                    "B01与普通合约同一资金费只计普通合约canonical一次"
                    if b01_raw
                    else "普通合约canonical只计一次"
                ),
            }
        )
        future_row = unified_by_source[source_id]
        future_row["candidate_position_cycle_ids"] = "|".join(candidates)
        future_row["cycle_allocation_status"] = (
            "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CYCLE_FUNDING"
        )
        future_row["account_scope"] = (
            "COPY_TRADING_PORTFOLIO"
            if cycle_origin.get(assigned_cycle) == "COPY_TRADING"
            else "UM_FUTURES_ACCOUNT"
        )

    rebate_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    rebate_count_by_cycle: dict[str, int] = collections.defaultdict(int)
    for row in unified:

            row["source_dataset"] == "FUTURES_LEDGER"
            and row["source_business_type_standard"] == "COMMISSION_REBATE"
        ):
            candidates = pipe_ids(row.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
            if len(candidates) == 1:
                rebate_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += (
                    decimal_value(row["amount_signed_exact"]) or ZERO
                )
                rebate_count_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += 1
                row["cycle_allocation_status"] = "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CANDIDATE_NOT_DIRECT"

def add_dataset(
        key: str,
        title: str,
        relative_output: str,
        rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
        notes: str,
        warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        columns = column_defs(rows)
        data_path = WORK_DIR / f"{key}.jsonl"
        write_jsonl(data_path, rows)
        manifest["datasets"].append(
            {
                "key": key,
                "title": title,
                "notes": notes,
                "output_path": str(STAGE_DIR / relative_output),
                "data_jsonl": str(data_path),
                "expected_record_count": len(rows),
                "data_columns": columns,
                "field_description_rows": field_rows(columns),
                "warnings": warnings or [{"状态": "无新增阻断异常"}],
                "reconciliation": [
                    {
                        "check_item": "记录数量",
                        "source_count": len(rows),
                        "output_count": len(rows),
                        "difference": 0,
                        "status": "PASS",
                    }
                ],
                "source_info": [
                    {
                        "stage": "阶段07",
                        "input_scope": "阶段04—06正式输入/B01/原始截图只读",
                        "output_scope": relative_output,
                        "build_script": str(SCRIPT.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        "xlsx_authoring_engine": "@oai/artifact-tool",
                        "phase08_executed": "否",
                    }
                ],
            }
        )

        elif len(candidates) == 2:
            matching = [
                cycle_id
                for cycle_id in candidates

                == ("COPY_TRADING" if b01_raw else "PERSONAL_ACTIVE")
            ]
            if len(matching) != 1:
                raise RuntimeError(f"资金费账户范围消歧失败：{source_id}")

    funding_events_by_cycle: dict[str, list[str]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    funding_candidate_by_source = {
        str(row["funding_event_record_id"]): row for row in funding_candidates
    }
    for candidate in funding_candidates:
        source_id = str(candidate["funding_event_record_id"])
        candidates = pipe_ids(candidate.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
        b01_raw = future_source_to_b01.get(source_id)
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            assigned_cycle = candidates[0]
            attribution = "UNIQUE_OPEN_CYCLE_AT_SETTLEMENT"
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F3"
        elif len(candidates) == 2:
            matching = [
                cycle_id
                for cycle_id in candidates
                if cycle_origin.get(cycle_id)
                == ("COPY_TRADING" if b01_raw else "PERSONAL_ACTIVE")
            ]
            if len(matching) != 1:
                raise RuntimeError(f"资金费账户范围消歧失败：{source_id}")
            assigned_cycle = matching[0]
            attribution = (
                "B01_DIRECT_COPY_EVENT"
                if b01_raw
                else "B01_IDENTIFIED_COPY_COUNTERPART_LEAVES_NORMAL_ACCOUNT_EVENT"
            )
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F2+F3" if b01_raw else "F3"
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(f"资金费候选数异常：{source_id} {len(candidates)}")
        amount = decimal_value(candidate.get("amount")) or ZERO
        funding_by_cycle[assigned_cycle] += amount
        funding_events_by_cycle[assigned_cycle].append(source_id)
        funding_allocation_rows.append(
            {
                **candidate,
                "assigned_position_cycle_id": assigned_cycle,
                "assigned_T_or_U": (
                    cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("manual_review_trade_ids")
                    or cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("u_number")
                ),
                "trading_origin": cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("trading_origin"),
                "ordinary_or_copy_attribution": (
                    "COPY" if b01_raw else "NORMAL_FUTURES"
                ),
                "B01_standard_record_id": (
                    b01_raw.get("standard_record_id") if b01_raw else None
                ),
                "stage07_attribution_basis": attribution,
                "stage07_attribution_confidence": confidence,
                "stage07_evidence_level": evidence_level,
                "stage07_allocation_status": "ALLOCATED_WITH_ACCOUNT_SCOPE_EVIDENCE",
                "double_count_prevention": (
                    "B01与普通合约同一资金费只计普通合约canonical一次"
                    if b01_raw
                    else "普通合约canonical只计一次"
                ),
            }
        )
        future_row = unified_by_source[source_id]
        future_row["candidate_position_cycle_ids"] = "|".join(candidates)
        future_row["cycle_allocation_status"] = (
            "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CYCLE_FUNDING"
        )
        future_row["account_scope"] = (
            "COPY_TRADING_PORTFOLIO"
            if cycle_origin.get(assigned_cycle) == "COPY_TRADING"
            else "UM_FUTURES_ACCOUNT"

    # 手续费返还只形成周期候选，不因缺少直接业务ID而强制计入周期现金结果。
    rebate_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    rebate_count_by_cycle: dict[str, int] = collections.defaultdict(int)
    for row in unified:
        if (
            row["source_dataset"] == "FUTURES_LEDGER"
            and row["source_business_type_standard"] == "COMMISSION_REBATE"
        ):
            candidates = pipe_ids(row.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
            if len(candidates) == 1:
                rebate_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += (
                    decimal_value(row["amount_signed_exact"]) or ZERO
                )
                rebate_count_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += 1
                row["cycle_allocation_status"] = "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CANDIDATE_NOT_DIRECT"

# 资金费：48个单候选；6个双候选通过B01跟单侧直接证据拆分账户范围。
    funding_allocation_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    funding_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    funding_events_by_cycle: dict[str, list[str]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    funding_candidate_by_source = {
        str(row["funding_event_record_id"]): row for row in funding_candidates
    }
    for candidate in funding_candidates:
        source_id = str(candidate["funding_event_record_id"])
        candidates = pipe_ids(candidate.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
        b01_raw = future_source_to_b01.get(source_id)
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            assigned_cycle = candidates[0]
            attribution = "UNIQUE_OPEN_CYCLE_AT_SETTLEMENT"
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F3"
        elif len(candidates) == 2:
            matching = [
                cycle_id
                for cycle_id in candidates
                if cycle_origin.get(cycle_id)
                == ("COPY_TRADING" if b01_raw else "PERSONAL_ACTIVE")
            ]
            if len(matching) != 1:
                raise RuntimeError(f"资金费账户范围消歧失败：{source_id}")
            assigned_cycle = matching[0]
            attribution = (
                "B01_DIRECT_COPY_EVENT"
                if b01_raw
                else "B01_IDENTIFIED_COPY_COUNTERPART_LEAVES_NORMAL_ACCOUNT_EVENT"
            )
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F2+F3" if b01_raw else "F3"
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(f"资金费候选数异常：{source_id} {len(candidates)}")
        amount = decimal_value(candidate.get("amount")) or ZERO
        funding_by_cycle[assigned_cycle] += amount
        funding_events_by_cycle[assigned_cycle].append(source_id)
        funding_allocation_rows.append(
            {
                **candidate,
                "assigned_position_cycle_id": assigned_cycle,
                "assigned_T_or_U": (
                    cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("manual_review_trade_ids")
                    or cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("u_number")
                ),
                "trading_origin": cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("trading_origin"),
                "ordinary_or_copy_attribution": (
                    "COPY" if b01_raw else "NORMAL_FUTURES"
                ),
                "B01_standard_record_id": (
                    b01_raw.get("standard_record_id") if b01_raw else None
                ),
                "stage07_attribution_basis": attribution,
                "stage07_attribution_confidence": confidence,
                "stage07_evidence_level": evidence_level,
                "stage07_allocation_status": "ALLOCATED_WITH_ACCOUNT_SCOPE_EVIDENCE",
                "double_count_prevention": (
                    "B01与普通合约同一资金费只计普通合约canonical一次"
                    if b01_raw
                    else "普通合约canonical只计一次"
                ),
            }
        )
        future_row = unified_by_source[source_id]
        future_row["candidate_position_cycle_ids"] = "|".join(candidates)
        future_row["cycle_allocation_status"] = (
            "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CYCLE_FUNDING"
        )
        future_row["account_scope"] = (
            "COPY_TRADING_PORTFOLIO"
            if cycle_origin.get(assigned_cycle) == "COPY_TRADING"
            else "UM_FUTURES_ACCOUNT"
        )

    if len(funding_allocation_rows) != 54:
        raise RuntimeError("54笔资金费未全部完成阶段07账户范围消歧")

    # 手续费返还只形成周期候选，不因缺少直接业务ID而强制计入周期现金结果。
    rebate_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    rebate_count_by_cycle: dict[str, int] = collections.defaultdict(int)
    for row in unified:
        if (
            row["source_dataset"] == "FUTURES_LEDGER"
            and row["source_business_type_standard"] == "COMMISSION_REBATE"
        ):
            candidates = pipe_ids(row.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
            if len(candidates) == 1:
                rebate_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += (
                    decimal_value(row["amount_signed_exact"]) or ZERO
                )
                rebate_count_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += 1
                row["cycle_allocation_status"] = "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CANDIDATE_NOT_DIRECT"

# 资金费：48个单候选；6个双候选通过B01跟单侧直接证据拆分账户范围。
    funding_allocation_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    funding_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    funding_events_by_cycle: dict[str, list[str]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    funding_candidate_by_source = {
        str(row["funding_event_record_id"]): row for row in funding_candidates
    }
    for candidate in funding_candidates:
        source_id = str(candidate["funding_event_record_id"])
        candidates = pipe_ids(candidate.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
        b01_raw = future_source_to_b01.get(source_id)
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            assigned_cycle = candidates[0]
            attribution = "UNIQUE_OPEN_CYCLE_AT_SETTLEMENT"
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F3"
        elif len(candidates) == 2:
            matching = [
                cycle_id
                for cycle_id in candidates
                if cycle_origin.get(cycle_id)
                == ("COPY_TRADING" if b01_raw else "PERSONAL_ACTIVE")
            ]
            if len(matching) != 1:
                raise RuntimeError(f"资金费账户范围消歧失败：{source_id}")
            assigned_cycle = matching[0]
            attribution = (
                "B01_DIRECT_COPY_EVENT"
                if b01_raw
                else "B01_IDENTIFIED_COPY_COUNTERPART_LEAVES_NORMAL_ACCOUNT_EVENT"
            )
            confidence = "高"
            evidence_level = "F2+F3" if b01_raw else "F3"
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(f"资金费候选数异常：{source_id} {len(candidates)}")
        amount = decimal_value(candidate.get("amount")) or ZERO
        funding_by_cycle[assigned_cycle] += amount
        funding_events_by_cycle[assigned_cycle].append(source_id)
        funding_allocation_rows.append(
            {
                **candidate,
                "assigned_position_cycle_id": assigned_cycle,
                "assigned_T_or_U": (
                    cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("manual_review_trade_ids")
                    or cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("u_number")
                ),
                "trading_origin": cycle_by_id[assigned_cycle].get("trading_origin"),
                "ordinary_or_copy_attribution": (
                    "COPY" if b01_raw else "NORMAL_FUTURES"
                ),
                "B01_standard_record_id": (
                    b01_raw.get("standard_record_id") if b01_raw else None
                ),
                "stage07_attribution_basis": attribution,
                "stage07_attribution_confidence": confidence,
                "stage07_evidence_level": evidence_level,
                "stage07_allocation_status": "ALLOCATED_WITH_ACCOUNT_SCOPE_EVIDENCE",
                "double_count_prevention": (
                    "B01与普通合约同一资金费只计普通合约canonical一次"
                    if b01_raw
                    else "普通合约canonical只计一次"
                ),
            }
        )
        future_row = unified_by_source[source_id]
        future_row["candidate_position_cycle_ids"] = "|".join(candidates)
        future_row["cycle_allocation_status"] = (
            "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CYCLE_FUNDING"
        )
        future_row["account_scope"] = (
            "COPY_TRADING_PORTFOLIO"
            if cycle_origin.get(assigned_cycle) == "COPY_TRADING"
            else "UM_FUTURES_ACCOUNT"
        )

    if len(funding_allocation_rows) != 54:
        raise RuntimeError("54笔资金费未全部完成阶段07账户范围消歧")

    # 手续费返还只形成周期候选，不因缺少直接业务ID而强制计入周期现金结果。
    rebate_by_cycle: dict[str, Decimal] = collections.defaultdict(Decimal)
    rebate_count_by_cycle: dict[str, int] = collections.defaultdict(int)
    for row in unified:
        if (
            row["source_dataset"] == "FUTURES_LEDGER"
            and row["source_business_type_standard"] == "COMMISSION_REBATE"
        ):
            candidates = pipe_ids(row.get("candidate_position_cycle_ids"))
            if len(candidates) == 1:
                rebate_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += (
                    decimal_value(row["amount_signed_exact"]) or ZERO
                )
                rebate_count_by_cycle[candidates[0]] += 1
                row["cycle_allocation_status"] = "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CANDIDATE_NOT_DIRECT"
